We're worried about every mail-in voter getting their ballot in on time, but especially those most vulnerable to this change, like the elderly, rural Americans who live far from USPS regional facilities, our military service members, and young people who are voting by mail away from home. None of them deserve to be disenfranchised from our elections over DOGE's cost-cutting measures.
Whether you can fuel our work today or not, we appreciate your support and we hope you can spread the word about this USPS change to your friends, family, and colleagues. You never know how a quick mention of something like this news might truly impact someone else's life.

My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
| | |
---
Friend,
I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the U.S. Senate. My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of antisemitism is part of my story – as it is for so many Jews who are too often made to feel like outsiders or that they are less than.
**_[Will you please make a gift of $5 or more now to help me continue to fight antisemitism in Washington and make positive change for all communities in Nevada and across the country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130727377/618716540/1781803786?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5752-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODhlMTMwMy1kMzQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=14Ou89B4k-fLY129-9tAGkWlGFt3t5L_PVWRaqzYA1g=)_**

When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a swimming pool with my mom when a lifeguard on duty told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish – and that we had to leave the pool immediately because of it. My mom never forgot that interaction.
Nearly every Jewish American has had a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today.
Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. MULTIPLE deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters.
All of it is wrong, and addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. **That is why:**
* I founded the Senate’s first-ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism – which now includes more than half the Senate as members.

* I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate.

* I introduced bipartisan legislation to address antisemitism on college campuses across the country.

* I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador.

* I introduced and successfully passed into law the reauthorization of the _Never Again Education Act_ , which helps educate our communities about the Holocaust.

* I recently led the charge to stop the Trump administration from weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas.

When I think about this work, I think about being that little girl with her mom again. Every day, I'm fighting to make our country a place where _nobody_ is targeted because of their faith or who they are – whether it’s a swimming pool, a house of worship, or the U.S. military.
We have made progress over the years in fighting back against antisemitism, but there is still so much more work for me to do – and your support helps power my fight in the Senate. body:
We’re collecting stories from people who know small towns best.
#
Peter,
Small towns across America are struggling. Too many politicians would rather sow division and let robber barons hollow out local economies than do the work to fix it.
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
We can build a country where small towns have a real voice in our politics. That starts with having conversations and listening.
**We’re collecting stories from people who know small towns best.[If you grew up in a small town, live in one, or have a story you think we should hear, can you take a moment to share it with Tim and our team?](https://act.timwalz.com/survey/small-town-stories/?source=em20260504-586&t=1&akid=586%2E34582%2EQnkHtS)**
**[Share Your Story ››](https://act.timwalz.com/survey/small-town-stories/?source=em20260504-586&t=2&akid=586%2E34582%2EQnkHtS)**
We’re making a plan to reach voters in small towns across the country — and your stories will help shape it. You know what the reality is on the ground for the people who’ve been ignored by our leaders for far too long.
Building real political power isn’t easy, but we’re going to expand our coalition one conversation and one town at a time. With your help, we will make sure our elected officials can’t ignore small towns any longer.
[**Please share your small town story today by filling out this form →**](https://act.timwalz.com/survey/small-town-stories/?source=em20260504-586&t=3&akid=586%2E34582%2EQnkHtS)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Derek, We know you probably get a lot of emails asking you how you feel about the Trump administration. We know that those emails probably end in requests for money. Chances are, if you’re getting this email, you’re not a big fan.** We don’t need to go into the hundreds of reasons you don’t like him. You’ve been hearing them for the last decade. We know you’re sick of it. Instead, we’re going to tell you what Democrats are doing right now to fight back and ensure that we win control of Congress this November. Democrats at all levels are doing everything they can to improve life for their constituents despite the chaos of the Trump administration. In Virginia, Governor Abigail Spanberger established **the first paid family and medical leave program in the South.** In New York City, Mayor Zohran Mamdani established more than **$1.6 billion in funding for universal childcare** , won more than **$34 million in repairs for tenants** , and achieved **record-low crime rates.** On the ground, Democrats are doing the work to win the 2026 elections as we speak. We are hiring hundreds of new organizers — some of whom are already working in Arizona — to register tens of thousands of new Democrats in swing states. [**So, Derek, we’re asking you to give $7 to the DNC today. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsFlYb8tSgv_iNH9eUO8IibbLOfX6PT-3gGyMq8W09rTWGkhpOgx1v3_y0wksFDKhC57umKjg75i7zm7NBFpOE9lWw97IYC8yPYy0Kk-UeyQi8kYtPLtV6LYtIE7v0wNmA56BdluaCviD2JGvI1x58wH0bpdITVD5-m4O2PGXWLYrkQDb9qslZCYKmqkzu665fzsqw2yh1hW8_UWN0ikp6PXArzjIh5q0hrZIQgNwRu_1paDjNqsPHyV28YGtmS8-6OzBNGdMZwGsjR016v-2NEuFESgCHowD7K9TjRvVrQpe9LXvTor-wiQCZf4YsQb43M4KangT6s3C1auI3yr3Fn/4qc/9AluqGHzQ1epUZDW2iqjKw/h0/h001.vNI9qzXrojZn5lq_ilnZ03dDsUzXwK2hAwPRooEy_v4)Friend — I’ve spent my life working with families who are doing everything right: working hard, raising kids, trying to get ahead.But one medical bill can still throw everything into crisis. And now we’re seeing fewer people able to afford healthcare coverage — _not because they don’t need it. Because they can’t afford it._ I’ve sat with people who had to choose between paying rent and seeing a doctor. I’ve seen what happens when someone delays care because it costs too much. **That is why I voted to expand Medicaid, and it is exactly why I’m running for Congress.** We should be expanding healthcare, not watching people lose it. We should be lowering costs, not pushing families out of coverage. But that won’t happen unless we’re willing to take on the people profiting from this system. **[If you can, please chip in what you’re able to give today. clean_body: | | | — I’ve spent my life working with families who are doing everything right: working hard, raising kids, trying to get ahead.But one medical bill can still throw everything into crisis. And now we’re seeing fewer people able to afford healthcare coverage — not because they don’t need it. Because they can’t afford it. I’ve sat with people who had to choose between paying rent and seeing a doctor. I’ve seen what happens when someone delays care because it costs too much. That is why I voted to expand Medicaid, and it is exactly why I’m running for Congress. We should be expanding healthcare, not watching people lose it. We should be lowering costs, not pushing families out of coverage. But that won’t happen unless we’re willing to take on the people profiting from this system. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. This shouldn’t be happening in this country. Together, we’re going to change it. Last week, my buddy Adam Mockler absolutely triggered and embarrassed CNN's top MAGA talking head, Scott Jennings, over the war on Iran. He clowned him so badly on Trump's war being a failure that Jennings dropped an F-bomb, throwing a temper tantrum on live national television.
And I've been thinking about why Adam, specifically, triggers these MAGA influencers so damn much. I go on right-wing media all the time--I get under their skin too. It's easy to say they just can't take a punch, that they're threatened by anyone who pokes holes in their worldview. That's true. But with Adam, it feels more specific.
It's his age.
We're watching another disastrous conflict in the Middle East unfold--one that hasn't made you safer, your groceries more affordable, or health care more accessible. And the same failed leaders who pushed us into Iraq are now out here carrying water for Trump and selling this war.
Here's the reality: the same people who've failed us for decades want another forever war, and they want his generation to go fight it. Because it's not going to be them or their kids. So why would they care?
Donald Trump is 79 years old. He's not going to serve. None of his kids or grandkids are going to serve.
Lindsey Graham is 70. No kids.
Benjamin Netanyahu is 76. And, as has been widely reported, his son has been in Miami, avoiding reserve service.
Think about that.
So what you're really looking at is a group of people who are perfectly comfortable sending a younger generation to die in another war, while hoping that generation stays quiet and doesn't push back.
That's where Adam comes in--and that's what rattles them.
Because he's not just informed--he is a reflection of the very people they're losing. Young people are struggling. Young people who can't afford homes, can't start families, can't get ahead, and definitely don't want to be shipped off to another endless war.
And this is the part that doesn't get talked about enough. You've got a whole class of people--guys like Scott Jennings and a lot of voices on the right--who constantly talk down to young people. The message is always the same: you don't know anything, you're too online, you haven't lived long enough to understand how the world works.
But look at who that's coming from.

These are the same people who backed the Iraq War, who supported the policies that helped crash the economy, who ignored climate change for decades, and who are now lining up behind another potential conflict. And after all of that, they still feel entitled to lecture the next generation about judgment and experience.
Young people might not have been old enough to understand those decisions when they were made--but they're the ones living with the consequences now. They're the ones dealing with student debt that keeps compounding, an economy that makes it incredibly hard to get a foothold, a housing market that feels completely out of reach, and a future that looks increasingly unstable--from climate to war to basic economic security.
So when people like Adam push back--when they question it, when they refuse to just fall in line--they get dismissed as naive or arrogant. They're called the "headphone generation." They're told to shut their fucking mouths on live television. It is patronizing and insulting.
Because if anything, this generation is more informed, more connected, and more aware than a lot of us were at their age.
They're angry. They should be. We've made it harder at every step to build a stable life, and then we turn around and act like their frustration is the problem instead of the conditions that created it.
What's actually happening is a generational shift that a lot of people in power are uncomfortable with. Younger voices aren't waiting their turn anymore. They're engaging now, pushing back now, and demanding a say in decisions that are going to shape the rest of their lives.
Adam is reflective of that. He's not feeding the anger--he's channeling it into something grounded, informed, and actually useful. And they hate that.
Because he's also a mirror--a reflection of a generation that's been dismissed, talked down to, and told to stay quiet while inheriting the consequences of decades of bad decisions.
That generation isn't quiet. They're fed up--and they're ready to push for something better.
And that's what scares people who've been clinging to power for years and just won't let go. So they lash out. They patronize. They throw temper tantrums. They act like toddlers.
Adam doesn't. And there are a lot more like him.
So they go after him the only way they can--not on substance, but on his age. "Why should we listen to you? You're just a young guy on the internet."
Okay--then why the hell should we keep listening to the people who got us into these wars in the first place?
Seriously: are you better off because we invaded Iraq? Are you better off because of this Iran conflict? Of course not. And they know it. They just can't defend it on the merits.
So instead, they deflect. They call him smug. They mock how he looks. It's pathetic and childish.
Because Adam represents something they can't control: a younger voice that's increasingly more credible, prepared, and actually resonating with people they're losing fast.
They try to tear him down, and he just shows up ready--grounded in what he believes and able to explain it without losing his cool. Meanwhile, they've got no real solutions to improve your life.
That's the real reason Adam Mockler scares them.
Not just because of what he's saying--but because of who's listening.

You don't need a political science degree to understand there are forces looking to reshape America's political and social structure. I think it's important to openly discuss the events which have caused so much carnage and disharmony in our nation the last couple of years. Identifying bad actors will be key to understanding motives and rationale, for what many believe is an attempt to dismantle our republic.
We must understand all the dynamics at play and how fragile our republic truly is. This is the first generation in America's history that believes capitalism is not better than the alternative. This is the mantra being touted openly in American institutions. Fueled by a radical faction of progressives, they are a dangerous group built on manufactured grievances and supposed injustices.

America's public schools and higher education are openly peddling the oppressive doctrine of Marxism and its manifesto. Intellectuals in America's schools radicalize the minds of young people by teaching them that capitalism is oppressive. Now factor in teaching radical doctrines like CRT (critical race theory), where white students are taught that they are the oppressors, and black students are taught that they are oppressed; it's no wonder children and young adults are oblivious to the repressive viewpoint debasing their young minds.
A recent Harvard study showed that most millennials believe the "American dream is dead." Another Pew poll found that 43% of millennials feel positive about the word "socialism" compared to less than half that for people over 50. Most young people simply do not understand the truisms of the oppressive governing doctrines.

Their goal is, the elimination of private property through redistribution, nationalization of private businesses, end of religious freedom, criminalizing free speech and appointing intellectuals to oversee the masses.
Countries like China give great insight to the inner workings and life under communistic rule in the 21st century. Since the early 1900s, it is estimated that roughly 150 million people have been killed at the hands of communist regimes, although many believe that number is low. Mass executions and forced labor camps, imprisonment, man-made hunger, extreme poverty, organ harvesting, and enslavement still exist in these countries today. Since the CCP takeover of China, it's estimated that 80 million people have perished at the hands of the authoritarian regime; and sadly, these atrocities continue this very day.

How that translates in America today is, toppling statues, denying history, tearing down monuments, marginalizing past American heroes and the elimination of history in the classrooms. These are all classic communist government tactics. Now add rioting in the streets, civil unrest, pandemic fears, economic uncertainty, civil rights suppression, and you can see the perfect storm for a neo-Marxist culture manifestation.
All you need to do is look across the American landscape at cities like San Francisco, Chicago, Philadelphia, DC, New York, and Seattle to see Marxism in action. A few elected elites at the top, while the rest are scrambling just to survive the day uninjured or perhaps worse, while toiling in extreme poverty. Every one of these once thriving metropolises have been decimated by progressive democrat elected leaders and their "woke" ideology and mob mentality.
The term "woke "is a bigoted expression of a radicalized policy that seems intent on committing harm to the innocents through prejudices of our fellow man. Anything born from hated will simply reproduce more hatred.
At its core, the woke mob and its cancel culture mantra are nothing more than breeding grounds for toxicity that hides behind a facade of moral righteousness. They have managed to infiltrate the minds of the next generation with delusions of grandeur regarding cultural revolution; and they will spiral out of control very quickly with the acquiescence of America's educational institutions.
The cult of wokeness is utilizing our youth to dismantle American society due to its misguided belief that America is steeped in bigoted principles. They have also figured out how to become profiteers off the conscience of good people, so apparently nothing is off the table in their quest for social supremacy.
This one-sided irrational viewpoint is tantamount to generational extortion on the grandest of scales and will have devastating results. Our young people have received the inheritance of a free people's republic and should feel duty bound to protect it. It is the duty of each generation to teach this basic concept to the next.

body:
Pete is all in for Chris. Now, all we need is you.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=6462%2E582294%2EmjNcA8)
Pete Buttigieg knows that New Hampshire’s U.S. Senate seat is a must-win for Democrats. **It’s why he endorsed Chris Pappas’s campaign.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260504_1.sr5Iwe&refcode=em20260504-1&t=2&akid=6462%2E582294%2EmjNcA8)
Pete understands that we can’t take back the Senate majority without winning in New Hampshire. That’s why he and dozens of other Democratic leaders from across the nation are sounding the alarm about the stakes of our race.
Here’s what he said about our race:
_“Chris would make history as the first out gay man elected to the U.S. Senate. But what matters most is that he’s running for the right reasons – to make life better for working families, protect our democracy, and bring seriousness and decency to the work ahead.”_
Trump and his right-wing allies are throwing everything they’ve got at this race to help our GOP opponent John Sununu take the lead. And it’s working: **Polls are showing this race is virtually TIED.** We can win, but not unless we see a surge of support for Chris before it’s too late.
Pete Buttigieg is all in for Chris. Now, all we need is you. ⤵️
**[Will you join Pete in supporting Chris Pappas for U.S. Senate by donating your first-ever $5 to our campaign right now?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260504_1.sr5Iwe&refcode=em20260504-1&t=3&akid=6462%2E582294%2EmjNcA8)**

Gratefully,
Team Chris Pappas
P.S. Chris was so humbled to receive this endorsement from Pete. During the Biden Administration, they worked together to bring infrastructure resources to communities across New Hampshire. Pete has seen Chris deliver for Granite Staters up close, and they’re both counting on your support today. **[If you can make a donation of ANY amount to support Chris and win the Senate, your contribution would go a long way.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260504_1.sr5Iwe&refcode=em20260504-1&t=23&akid=6462%2E582294%2EmjNcA8)**

I've noticed less water coming through lately... and you might think that will make those occasional leaks and urges better...

But the truth is, too much water is NOT the cause of your bathroom struggles...

In fact, it's the opposite.

Once you hit 50, a few things got out of whack.

**Kidneys stopped filtering fluid as well as they once did** \- causing concentrated urine that irritates your bladder and causes spontaneous urges.

**Thirst signals slow down, causing you to drink less** \- making bladder muscles lazy and causing occasional leaks.

Luckily, US Army researchers decoded a shockingly easy water trick with two ingredients that can improve muscle strength by 36%, improve bladder health by 58%, and give you control back...

name: Jim Jordan
subject: I'll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you!

After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Friend!
| Friend,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._

That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.

| | **I wanted you to hear it from me: I have filed for reelection.** Representing Northwest Washington is a privilege I do not take for granted. This is home. Northwest Washington is where I was born and raised, where my family has lived for more than a century. The values I bring to this work come from my parents. My dad was a union power line worker, and my mom managed the books while raising eight kids in Arlington. **They taught me the importance of hard work, looking out for one another, and serving our community — lessons I carry with me every day in Congress, and informed my decision to run for reelection.** There is still more work to do, and working families deserve a government that is focused on lowering costs and delivering _real_ results. **Right now, too many families are feeling squeezed. Child care, health care, gas, housing, groceries, and energy prices are simply too high.** I am committed to continuing the fight in Congress to bring those costs down and ease the burden on your household. **At the same time, I will keep working to deliver for our communities here at home:** investing in jobs and infrastructure across Northwest Washington, combating the threat of fentanyl and opioids by supporting our local law enforcement, and ensuring federal agencies like ICE are held to the same standards as all other law enforcement agencies. clean_body: Representing Northwest Washington is a privilege I do not take for granted. | | | | I wanted you to hear it from me: I have filed for reelection. Representing Northwest Washington is a privilege I do not take for granted. This is home. Northwest Washington is where I was born and raised, where my family has lived for more than a century. The values I bring to this work come from my parents. My dad was a union power line worker, and my mom managed the books while raising eight kids in Arlington. They taught me the importance of hard work, looking out for one another, and serving our community — lessons I carry with me every day in Congress, and informed my decision to run for reelection. There is still more work to do, and working families deserve a government that is focused on lowering costs and delivering real results. Right now, too many families are feeling squeezed. Child care, health care, gas, housing, groceries, and energy prices are simply too high. I am committed to continuing the fight in Congress to bring those costs down and ease the burden on your household. At the same time, I will keep working to deliver for our communities here at home: investing in jobs and infrastructure across Northwest Washington, combating the threat of fentanyl and opioids by supporting our local law enforcement, and ensuring federal agencies like ICE are held to the same standards as all other law enforcement agencies. In the months ahead, I will be traveling across Northwest Washington to listen, learn, and earn your support. I hope you will be part of this campaign. I look forward to discussing what you need from Congress to ensure that Northwest Washington continues to be a great place to live, work, and raise a family. = = Thank you for your continued support. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Texans are rejecting GOP chaos and corruption
body:
Change is here, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Something big just happened in Texas, Peter.
**This weekend, voters across the state showed what it looks like to fight back at the ballot box.**
From city halls to school boards, Texans rejected the GOP’s chaos and corruption and chose leaders who will actually show up and do the work.
* In Pearland, **Quentin Wiltz** was elected mayor in a Republican stronghold.
* In Arlington, **Brittney Garcia-Dumas** flipped a city council seat in the 5th district.
* In Denton, **Jordan Villarreal** won a city council seat in the 1st district, and **Anita Martinez-Strickland** won a seat on the Denton ISD Board of Trustees.
* In Grapevine, **Matthew White, Lindsey Sheguit,** and **Darrell Brown** ousted GOP-aligned incumbents on the Grapevine-Colleyville Independent School District Board.
* In San Antonio, **Michael Adam Wulczyn** and **Caprice Garcia** flipped two seats on the North East ISD Board of Trustees.
* In Travis County, **Tiffany Bennett** and **Natalie Nugent** flipped two seats on the Lake Travis ISD Board of Trustees.

These races are all telling us something we’ve been hearing on the campaign trail: **Texans are tired of leaders who serve their donors first and us second. They want strong public schools and community leaders who work for them.**
So, if anyone tells you change can’t happen in Texas, point them to what happened this weekend — **change is already happening, Peter.**
**[We’re building a coalition to defeat Greg Abbott this November, and we need your help. If you’re ready to keep the momentum going, will you chip in $5 to power my campaign and flip Texas blue today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260504_1_local.wa4E0y&refcode=em20260504-1051&amount=5&t=1&akid=1051%2E299639%2EZWvyKZ)**

They want strong public schools and community leaders who work for them. So, if anyone tells you change can’t happen in Texas, point them to what happened this weekend — change is already happening, Peter. Thank you, Gina Hinojosa Email us: mailto:info@ginafortexas.com

### **You have to actively claim it, and the deadline is fast approaching.**
The **[National Taxpayer Advocate recently issued a stark warning](https://substack.com/redirect/c5b3c5f0-8b19-4ce4-837a-c5cd851aecc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : because of a federal court ruling involving the COVID disaster declaration, filing and payment deadlines were automatically postponed across the entire period from January 20, 2020, through May 11, 2023. Many people who paid penalties or interest during that time **may now be eligible for refunds or abatements.** The problem is that relief is not automatic. Taxpayers must file a claim to the IRS using Form 843, and in most cases, that still means paper filing. The absolute deadline to submit those claims is July 10, 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c5b3c5f0-8b19-4ce4-837a-c5cd851aecc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is one of those rare all too moments where the government **actually owes ordinary people money,** and yet the process has been left deliberately cumbersome. The IRS has not created a simple electronic portal or launched a major public awareness campaign. Instead, the burden falls on individual taxpayers to figure this out and act before the window closes.
**Which is why we are writing about it.**

**This is something people need to actively do.** If you filed tax returns, made payments, or had penalties assessed between early 2020 and mid-2023, you should check whether you might be owed money. The National Taxpayer Advocate has urged the IRS to do more to publicize the issue and make the process easier, **but so far that hasn 't happened.** Waiting for the government to fix this for you is likely a losing strategy!
The good news is that if you qualify, the potential benefit could be meaningful. Even relatively small refunds or penalty reductions can add up, especially for families who were already stretched thin during the pandemic years and afterwards. The bad news is that the **July 10, 2026 deadline is not far away in bureaucratic time,** and once it passes, the opportunity is gone for good.
This slow, quiet sorting out of COVID-era financial mistakes is long overdue. For years, the focus was on massive government spending and emergency programs. Now we're seeing the mundane but vitally important cleanup phase, **the part where ordinary taxpayers might actually recover some of what they lost** to penalties and interest they never should have owed in the first place.
Don't assume the IRS will reach out to you. T**hey won 't.** Don't assume someone else will handle this. **They won 't.** If there's even a chance you're owed money, it is worth investigating now. The process may be annoying, but **the potential payoff is real.**

name: research@voteractionproject.org
subject: Making ballots more accessible to citizens?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NPR: A federal law requires translated voting ballots but not in Arabic or Haitian Creole [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/NPR_BallotLanguages.png]
Section 203 of the 1965 Voting Rights Act has required certain states and local governments to provide voting ballots, registration forms and other election materials in more than just English. But not all languages are covered by Section 203's protections.
We want to hear from voters in your area to get their feelings on the topic. Will you take our one-question poll right away?
Team: Should ballots be available in more languages to make sure all citizens can vote?
By clicking a response below your answer will be automatically recorded:
YES [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=050426_2yes&amount=15] NO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=050426_2no&amount=15]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

First, Alexandria launched her re-election campaign to keep fighting in Congress in fierce advocacy of working people.

# **Rep. Grace Meng Endorses Esther Kim-Varet for Congress**
_First Asian American to Represent New York in Congress Backs Kim-Varet to Flip CA-40, Retire MAGA Incumbents Young Kim and Ken Calvert, and Help Deliver the Democratic House Majority_ **RANCHO SANTA MARGARITA, CA** – **Esther Kim-Varet** , frontrunner to flip California’s 40th Congressional District, today announced the endorsement of **Rep. Grace Meng (NY-06)** , the first Asian American to represent New York in Congress and one of the most influential AAPI voices in the House Democratic caucus. Meng has spent more than a decade in Congress championing immigrant communities, leading the congressional response to anti-Asian hate, and delivering for working families in Queens. **“Esther and I share a lot in common: both working moms of two young kids, both daughters of immigrants, raised by communities that taught us to fight for the families around us,”** said Rep. Grace Meng. **“The path to a Democratic House majority runs through districts like CA-40, and Esther is the only candidate who can flip it. I’m proud to endorse her.”** Esther Kim-Varet is the only Democrat in CA-40 with the resources, the grassroots movement, and the path to victory required to retire MAGA Rep. Young Kim and MAGA Rep. Ken Calvert. She has raised over **$2.8 million** from more than **60,000 individual contributions** , with no corporate or foreign PAC money whatsoever. | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMay 4, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**Oil & Gas Workers Association Endorses Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate** _Endorsement highlights Letlow’s strong support for Louisiana energy workers and America First energy policy_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, announced she has received the endorsement of the Oil & Gas Workers Association.
In announcing the endorsement, the organization emphasized Rep. Letlow’s direct engagement with workers across the state and her understanding of what it takes to keep America energy independent.
_“Oil & Gas Workers need people in D.C. who will listen to us and really understand all the things that have to be done for us to ‘Drill, baby, drill!’”_ **said the Oil & Gas Workers Association.** _“Julia Letlow takes time to visit Haynesville and Gulf of America service companies and LNG facilities to talk with us. Like President Donald Trump, Julia Letlow cares about American workers and will put our jobs and families first. Oil & Gas Workers Association is proud to endorse Julia Letlow for Senate.”_
Rep. Letlow said she is honored to have the support of workers who power Louisiana’s economy and fuel America’s energy future.
_“I am deeply grateful for the support of the Oil & Gas Workers Association and the hardworking men and women who keep our energy industry strong,”_ **said Rep. Letlow**. _“Louisiana is an energy state, and our workers are second to none. I have seen firsthand the pride they take in their work and the sacrifices they make for their families. In the U.S. Senate, I will always fight to protect their jobs, expand American energy production, and stand with President Trump to unleash our full energy potential.”_
Rep. Letlow has made energy policy a central part of her campaign, consistently advocating for an all-of-the-above strategy that prioritizes oil, gas, and LNG production while cutting federal red tape and opposing policies that threaten Louisiana jobs.
As a member of Congress, Rep. Letlow has built a record of standing with energy workers and supporting policies that strengthen Louisiana’s economy, reinforce American energy independence, and put working families first.
Learn more at [JuliaLetlow.com](https://us.list-manage.com/4pLPPxu3rdu?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

| Peter,

Let’s set the record straight.

David Trone is attacking my record on ICE and trying to mislead you about where I stand. But the facts are simple. _**David Trone voted for a Trump-backed bill that included over $200 million for ICE and has said, “We need to keep ICE.”**_ That’s his record. _Here’s mine:_

I have been**leading the fight to stop the ICE detention facility in Washington County.** I’ve demanded transparency, pushed back against secret plans, and stood with our community to block a facility that would harm families and strain local resources.

I’ve also been clear: we cannot give blank checks to agencies that operate without accountability or respect for basic rights.

This is what this race is about.

My opponent can spend millions trying to rewrite his record. But the truth matters. And so does leadership that is willing to stand up, ask hard questions, and fight for our communities.

The Washington Post editorial board took direct aim at Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson, zeroing in on what it described as a dismissive attitude toward growing concerns over taxes, business [...] In a move that signals growing tension between local and state authority, the city of El Cajon, California, has launched a legal challenge against the state’s sanctuary laws. Positioned near the Mexican border, the city’s leadership argues that California’s restrictions on cooperation with federal immigration enforcement have crossed into dangerous legal territory. subject: They charged him with a felony for stopping a riot
body:
Dear Patriot,
They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up.
They want to lock him away for using **non-lethal bean bag rounds** against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party.
I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed.
** [It has to stop — and I need your help to stop it.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=576938ecb1154024811dc1226ac8f705&_e=TqBN8bEwCZn3GnHNxaSWDSEBQNMuN_4aQCoVjcm97tUxxpC9-UEWcPPUQZ14dBlR1NL7gHa0BPf8_-Hkio-677CrIa08-SyMxJ_NJ5p_YNlj2sVWWTIi4xIF1BD57YOyigtNazdrSJb5k1PRR-dZeqyeaEwA_EAn__O_I949tVe8I7NtgP8mpnyf8UH7XmwAupGeSmERFMzJgD1Rjo-wpBIFmob4RhFYkD7aKNoZGusCS0QinPDKzqlMjPpPsIjo8PB6kM15pYhOg6gJ_j3nPuQBw5iGylaU1NyX3171MSSgBk0e1_wgNX8Mwncv9_angzhp4_8O_KotYBD15YrrrD6SchZjfYUBRvvg5U78-55GSJ4EZdOJbtRHGneER4cb9cMnncPT8XYkDePnRHlaB8zpNjBitEbvz1OUGPHuxGz511Y2OuOca_s2GShgra2H) **
It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse.
On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused.
**Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway.**
Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife
When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence.
That's it. That's the "crime."
Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted.
This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets.
And Jeff Teng is paying the price. His career is on hold. His future is uncertain. His trial has been delayed again and again — meaning this family has been living under this cloud for _years_ with no end in sight.
The National Center for Police Defense is standing with Jeff and his family — funding his legal defense and providing support while this ordeal drags on. But we cannot do it without you.

What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse. On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused. Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway. Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence. That's it. That's the "crime." Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted. This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets. And Jeff Teng is paying the price. His career is on hold. His future is uncertain. His trial has been delayed again and again — meaning this family has been living under this cloud for years with no end in sight. The National Center for Police Defense is standing with Jeff and his family — funding his legal defense and providing support while this ordeal drags on. But we cannot do it without you. I'm asking you to . $25. $50. $100. Whatever you can. Your gift goes to Jeff's defense and to supporting his family through this nightmare. Stand With Officer Teng Today Your gift funds Jeff's legal defense and supports his family through this nightmare. 100% of your donation goes toward Officer Teng's legal defense fund. The radical left is counting on your silence. They want you to think this is just one officer, one city, one story. It isn't. If they can prosecute 20+ officers for stopping a riot with non-lethal force, no officer anywhere is safe. Jeff Teng showed up. He held the line. He protected his partner, his city, and the rule of law — with every tool he was authorized to use. The least we can do is show up for him. Don't look away. Share this with every law enforcement supporter you know. And please, For Jeff. For every officer they're coming after next. Sincerely, Sheriff Joe Arpaio Former Sheriff, Maricopa County, Arizona Honorary Supporter, National Center for Police Defense P.S. Officer Jeff Teng is facing felony charges for stopping a riot. Last week, the Fifth Circuit sided with Louisiana and reinstated an outdated, medically unnecessary requirement that mifepristone be dispensed in person—threatening access by mail and at pharmacies nationwide. This morning, the Court temporarily agreed to stay the ruling until next Monday. But this fight is far from over.

Medication abortion accounts for more than 60% of abortions in the U.S. each year. Since _Roe_ was overturned, telehealth abortion requests have doubled. For people in rural areas—hours from the nearest clinic—it was a lifeline.
[PROTECT MIFE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130739371/618757597/1824768205?sourceid=1151337&utm_campaign=26emama-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=lavfda&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzIwODk2Ny1lZTQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QcfMybIttmiwDzDgaRn2eHfsrl26AhQDrOV5viD67v4=&emci=0d2590e4-7947-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=a7208967-ee47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

[More than 7.5 million people have used it safely. Hundreds of studies back it.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130739372/618757598/1824768205?sourceid=1151337&utm_campaign=26emama-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=lavfda&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzIwODk2Ny1lZTQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QcfMybIttmiwDzDgaRn2eHfsrl26AhQDrOV5viD67v4=&emci=0d2590e4-7947-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=a7208967-ee47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237) Restricting mifepristone is not about safety—it's about making abortion as difficult, expensive, and unreachable as possible.
[DEFEND ABORTION CARE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130739373/618757599/1824768205?sourceid=1151337&utm_campaign=26emama-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=lavfda&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzIwODk2Ny1lZTQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QcfMybIttmiwDzDgaRn2eHfsrl26AhQDrOV5viD67v4=&emci=0d2590e4-7947-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=a7208967-ee47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

We refuse to accept it.

[For decades, the Center for Reproductive Rights has been challenging coordinated attacks on your health care in courtrooms across the country, at every level.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/130739375/618757601/1824768205?sourceid=1151337&utm_campaign=26emama-0502aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=lavfda&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzIwODk2Ny1lZTQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QcfMybIttmiwDzDgaRn2eHfsrl26AhQDrOV5viD67v4=&emci=0d2590e4-7947-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=a7208967-ee47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

This fight is no different. But stopping these attacks requires sustained legal action, and our ability to fight and win depends on people like you. Stay with us—we'll keep you updated as things unfold.

In solidarity,

Center for Reproductive Rights

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130739459/618757950/463063231?refcode=em26_260503_gopcoh_fndd_gq_act___TS_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260503_gopcoh_fndd_gq_act___TS_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=20548f19-ef47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDU0OGYxOS1lZjQ3LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8cc9OCuPFRhs_ts9b9dzbqdNWSiJom66naX3fDZow0A=) **"House Republicans’ midterm silver lining: Money"** Voters are fed up, Peter, and Republicans know it.

But instead of listening to the needs of their constituents, top Republican leaders are turning to their megadonors to save their seats, and they've already raised **millions** of dollars. Their endgame is clear: overwhelm competitive races like WA-08 with sheer volume over quality candidates, all to protect their dwindling majorities in Congress.

In an election year as competitive and high-stakes as this one, the cost of running a competitive campaign only goes up. We need to be prepared to help Kim fight back against _even more_ pressure from national groups trying to tip the scales in their favor.

Closing the fundraising gaps in the goals we set isn't about matching the GOP dollar-for-dollar—it's about making sure this campaign has what it needs to compete, communicate, **and win.**

We'll be organizing in every community across our district, building a strong field operation, reaching voters early and often, and responding quickly when outside groups flood the airwaves with attacks. The reality is: none of that happens without the resources to support it.

[**There's still a lot of ground we need to cover in order to stay on track and ensure Kim doesn't lose even an ounce of momentum. name: Schumer Stand Down via Our Revolution
subject: Add your name: Tell Schumer to let the VOTERS decide
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Chuck Schumer thought he could hand-pick Maine’s Senate nominee from
Washington.

He recruited Gov. Janet Mills. He endorsed her campaign. He touted her as
a centerpiece of Democrats’ plan to win back the Senate. Now Mills has
dropped out before the primary even happened, after her campaign
flatlined, while Our Revolution-backed Graham Platner surged ahead.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37967?source=email-20260504&t=1011&akid=10682%2E5885482%2EUMudNr ]Headline: Bernie Sanders is destroying Chuck Schumer in the Democratic
Party's Civil War ahead of the midterms.

Even Senate Democrats are asking the obvious question: Why did Schumer
push so hard for a candidate voters clearly weren’t excited about?

The answer is simple. Washington insiders still think they can override
the grassroots and decide who deserves to run. That strategy keeps failing
– which is why we need to send Schumer a clear message today: stay out of
the primaries!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37967?source=email-20260504&t=1012&akid=10682%2E5885482%2EUMudNr ]Will you add your name now to tell Chuck Schumer and the Democratic
Senatorial Campaign Committee: Stay out of Democratic primaries and let
voters decide?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37967?source=email-20260504&t=1013&akid=10682%2E5885482%2EUMudNr ]ADD YOUR NAME

This isn’t just about Maine. Schumer and the party establishment are still
trying to shape contested primaries across the country, including key
Senate races in Michigan and Iowa, by backing corporate-friendly
candidates and encouraging super PACs to flood primaries with outside
money. Too often, the candidates with the strongest grassroots support are
treated like obstacles instead of the future of the Democratic Party.

Right now in Michigan, Our Revolution-backed Abdul El-Sayed is
neck-and-neck in the Democratic Senate primary against Haley Stevens – the
AIPAC-backed, Schumer-supported favorite of party insiders.

36% of voters are still undecided. That means this race is wide open. But
the establishment is already working to tip the scales before voters have
a real chance to decide for themselves. That’s not how we build the kind
of movement powerful enough to defeat Republicans, take back Congress, and
deliver for working people.

Maine should be a wake-up call. Schumer’s preferred candidate collapsed
because voters want something different. The Democratic establishment is
out of touch – and if they keep interfering in primaries, they’ll keep
alienating the very voters Democrats need to win.

Our Revolution was built to challenge this exact kind of insider politics.
We believe Democratic VOTERS should choose Democratic nominees.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/37967?source=email-20260504&t=1014&akid=10682%2E5885482%2EUMudNr ]If you agree, add your name today and demand that Chuck Schumer and the
DSCC stay out of Democratic primaries once and for all.

We’re tired of watching billionaires and super PACs drown out grassroots
campaigns. And we’re tired of party leaders ignoring the energy and ideas
coming from the people doing the organizing, knocking the doors, and
building the movement from the ground up. So let’s change it.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

Every Wednesday, my team and I have our big group meeting. It's with everyone from the folks who are helping me raise the money we need, to our incredible on-the-ground organizers and partners who have been doing the work in our city for years.
Right now, with just over a month until ballots are sent out, these meetings are getting even more critical as we work to nail down how we're going to reach voters we haven't been able to meet at the doors and who still don't know there's a choice on their ballot this year.
We've got to find a way to connect with these people - and I don't want it to be with one of those lame campaign ads with the factory-made feel that just drones on and on while you wait to skip them. I don't want our campaign to have those ads that are just like every campaign out there - because we're not like every campaign out there.

_From our recent gathering at the Lighthouse, photo courtesy of Holly Rainey_
I've been thinking a lot this week about what it means to live in community.
While Tennessee's leaders waste taxpayer money on a special session to redraw our congressional maps -- a move that does nothing for working families struggling with rising costs, healthcare access, or our underfunded schools -- I keep coming back to the same answer: **The only way forward is through, doing the slow, steady work of neighbors talking to neighbors.**
That's what we're doing in this campaign. Every phone call, every front porch conversation, every potluck and parade and picnic, we are weaving the kind of community no political stunt can pull apart. They want us scattered, exhausted, and distracted. Instead, we're going to continue building the foundation of a movement no gerrymander can break.
**In case you missed my last Substack, here 's what you can do now to fight this:**
* Find your TN Representative using the[ Find My Legislator](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6e9710f5-714d-44de-a5fc-1b6c422d9a14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tool.
* Call and email until your voice is heard! Tell them you oppose redrawing our state's Congressional maps, and condemn this act of chaotic distraction during an election year.
* **A simple script you can use:**

_I 'm a constituent calling to urge Representative [Name] to vote against the redistricting proposal in the special session. Redrawing maps mid-cycle is wrong, and I'm asking them to oppose it. _
* Flood your Representatives' social media accounts with comments and DMs expressing your opposition to this redistricting effort. Even on posts that aren't about the special session, make your discontent known.
* Share this information and call to action with your community - on social media and in personal calls, texts, and emails - and encourage them to do the same.
* **Don 't forget to VOTE in the City + County Primary on May 5!**

And then come do the essential work with us: [Phone bank on Tuesday and Thursday](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d0195cd-b56f-462a-954d-e0544adda134?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Knock doors in [North Knoxville on Saturday](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f94ab855-70c2-4f64-b562-69cd86cb640d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Join us at [Camp Cavalry next week](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4eadc411-9e1b-4731-b719-a0118854fb5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to learn how to bring the people you love into this community. We're launching a Relational Organizing program that's going to kick our movement into overdrive.
No matter how they try to discourage and divide us, we are resisting their chaos and building something better for all East Tennesseans.
I hope to see you there,
Michaela

I’m the proud son of political refugees. My parents came to this country because they believed in the promise of equal opportunity and real representation.

We’ve got more work ahead, but I’m grateful to be in this fight with you.

| | Dear Peter,
**We are excited to announce that Kshama Sawant is now on the ballot!**
Since we launched Kshama’s independent socialist campaign last summer, we have talked to tens of thousands of working people in Congressional District 9 and won support from donors in all 50 states, Washington DC and Puerto Rico.
That support has translated into over 800 working people signing up to volunteer and $525,000 raised from over 4,500 donors, with a median donation of just $25. Working people around the country recognize the historic importance of this campaign. That’s why across Congressional District 9, and all the way from Hawaii to New York City, our supporters have organized in-person or Zoom house party fundraisers to help elect Kshama to Congress.
## Strongest Ever Left/Progressive Challenge to Warmonger Adam Smith
We are proud to report that we have **MORE THAN SEVEN TIMES as many donors as Adam Smith** , whose campaign is being bankrolled by the ultra rich, the war industry, and the Zionist lobby.**And our total so far in the primary election cycle is already more than twice the amount that any left or progressive challenger to Adam Smith has** _**ever**_**raised in their entire campaign.**
Our campaign organized a highly successful contingent at Seattle’s May Day protest on Friday where we spoke about the need to FUND HEALTHCARE, NOT WAR! Kshama’s opponent, Adam Smith, has carried out the war-mongering, pro-billionaire agenda of the Democratic Party throughout his 29 years in Congress, and voted to fund every imperialist war, all the way from the war on Iraq to the genocide in Gaza. He voted to create ICE and repeatedly voted to fund it. He voted to break the railroad workers’ strike. In stark contrast, Kshama is fighting for free healthcare for all paid for by taxing the rich and for a permanent end to all military aid to Israel. Kshama is also fighting to shut down ICE and the detention centers and stop the deportations. Our campaign is calling for a $25/hour national minimum wage and national rent control.
Our campaign is canvassing working people virtually every day, and on Saturday, we held our **May Volunteer Day** at simultaneous locations all over Congressional District 9.
**We are also proud to report that our campaign gathered over 4,300 signatures to get Kshama on the ballot.** This is two and a half times the 1,740 signatures required for Congressional District 9, showing the huge support for Kshama and our campaign as well as the dedication of our volunteers, who gathered most of those signatures in the cold and rain of this winter and early spring.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/6yuD9CLaci2?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
| |
## Attacks By the Democratic and Republican Parties
At the same time that we have been gathering signatures from working people excited about our socialist campaign, we have grown increasingly concerned as we have watched the despicable attempts by the Democrats who run California to keep Green Party candidate Butch Ware off the ballot in the governor’s race. They have done so using blatantly dishonest and undemocratic means.
This attack is taking place because millions of working people are furious at Trump and at both parties of the billionaires. They are angry at the Democrats and Republicans because of the decades of attacks on working people, the imperialist wars, and the cost-of-living crisis. The Democratic Party has its lowest approval ratings in 35 years, which is even more stunning for a party that is not in the White House. And this is despite the deep unpopularity of Donald Trump and anger at the war on Iran and his vicious attacks on working people.
Butch Ware’s campaign is battling against undemocratic attacks by the Democratic Party in the courts, and has our full solidarity in that fight.
**Both the Democratic and Republican parties have a long track record of these kinds of attacks on ballot access and the basic democratic rights of working people.** The Democrats, in particular, have a history of trying to keep third party and independent candidates off the ballot and out of televised debates. Because the Democrats are so deeply unpopular at present, they are even more fearful of challenges from the left. They are especially afraid of **Kshama’s unparalleled track record** of overcoming obstacles to win working-class victories as a revolutionary socialist, and they absolutely do not want her in Congress.
We cannot rule out potential attempts to block our campaign in Washington state.
We were also quite concerned by the contradictory responses we got from the Secretary of State’s office regarding the filing process when using signatures to get on the ballot, with completely opposite answers to the same question being given by different people in the office.
We know that under capitalism, the state and its institutions are not on our side. Not only are they not neutral bodies, but when they see a real threat to the billionaires and multimillionaires, they are prepared to take the most blatant measures against working-class candidates. We saw this with the failed Right-Wing Recall attempt against Kshama Sawant in 2021, which was supported by the State Supreme Court despite the fact that all the charges were factually untrue.
Our campaign has also been concerned about the deeply irresponsible gathering of ballot petition signatures by a Super PAC calling itself "Movement for Kshama", despite the fact that Super PACs are not legally allowed to coordinate with election campaigns or make in-kind contributions to them. We published a [statement](https://us.list-manage.com/883kDvYvICp?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) explaining the serious dangers posed by the irresponsible and reckless approach by this Super PAC.
Relying on signatures to get on the ballot unfortunately puts a lot of additional power in the hands of the capitalist state. This is true not only in terms of how the state chooses to count (or not to count) signatures, but there could also be challenges to our petition format or other similar undemocratic measures, like those used against Butch Ware’s campaign.
**For all these reasons, our campaign decided to not rely on any ideas of neutrality or democracy by the capitalist state. Since we cannot assume they will honor the democratic wishes of those over 4,300 people who signed to put Kshama Sawant on the ballot, we chose to pay the filing fee.**
**As of this morning, Kshama Sawant is on the ballot, in our fight to elect her as the first ever revolutionary socialist in the U.S. Congress.**
We have previously gathered signatures to get on the ballot **in every single one of Kshama’s election campaigns**. We have done so because as a working-class, socialist campaign we see the signature gathering process as an invaluable opportunity to talk to many thousands of people about our socialist politics and antiwar, working-class political program. This is highly unusual — the vast majority of campaigns don't gather signatures at all because they are not looking to talk to working people. In fact, not one federal candidate from Washington state had done so in this decade.
**In each of our past campaigns we submitted our signatures to get on the ballot.** However, in the context of these potential undemocratic attacks, we have a responsibility, not only to all those who signed our petition, but to the entire working class, to do everything we can to ensure that Kshama’s revolutionary socialist campaign appears on the ballot.
[**The filing fee is $1,740, and we’d like to take this opportunity to appeal for you to donate to our campaign now and help CANCEL OUT the cost of the fee.**](https://us.list-manage.com/mqgToo3XN6W?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
**For the month of May, we are launching a fundraising drive for $75,000, to build on the momentum from officially getting on the ballot so we can go all-out to defeat warmonger Adam Smith.** Raising $75,000 in May would bring our campaign to $600,000 overall. [**Please donate now, and help us spread the word!**](https://us.list-manage.com/1AvIKabYTRf?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
We will be holding a second Volunteer Day in May later this month — stay tuned for details! In the meantime, we have volunteer opportunities almost every single day, so please go to our website to sign up to get involved.
If you haven’t yet done so, [**please RSVP now for our** _**Fund Healthcare Not War**_**May Town Hall meeting happening this Saturday, May 9th, at 2pm PT**](https://us.list-manage.com/L4PYzQVbZil?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) at Casa Latina in the Central District, with a livestream to watch from anywhere.
On May 20, we will be holding a [Labor for Kshama event](https://us.list-manage.com/sheCsIjNm9x?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) to build this campaign and to further the struggle to re-build a fighting labor movement. In Solidarity,Justin BareCampaign Manager

body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260504-partner_ms_tish_em_demandjustice.giZ6zU&refcode=em20260504-61420&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61420%2E1407376%2EOYpkKX ]A picture of Letitia James.

Hi, it’s Tish James, and I
want you to hear this directly from me:

I’m officially running for reelection as New York’s Attorney General.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260504-partner_ms_tish_em_demandjustice.giZ6zU&refcode=em20260504-61420&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61420%2E1407376%2EOYpkKX ]Before I share more, will you become a Founding Donor of my reelection
campaign by splitting a donation between Demand Justice PAC and my
campaign today?

Since 2019, I’ve had the honor of serving the people of New York. I’ve
taken on the powerful — from big corporations, to the ultra-wealthy, to
powerful politicians like Donald Trump — and delivered real results for
New Yorkers.

When the Trump administration pushed their dangerous and immoral policies
that target our immigrant neighbors, I fought back because protecting all
New Yorkers makes us stronger.

When Donald Trump defrauded the people of New York, I took him to court
and held him accountable.

And as Trump and extreme Republicans ramp up their attacks on everything
we stand for – threatening immigrants’ rights, raising prices for working
people, and launching efforts to roll back voting rights – I’m using the
full power of the attorney general’s office to fight back.

That’s why it’s no surprise Donald Trump is targeting me. He knows I won’t
stop holding him and his administration accountable, and he’s mobilizing
the entire weight of the Department of Justice to come after me because of
it.

But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it's that you can never back down
from a bully.

I’m running for reelection, and I need you on my side to keep
fighting for the rights of New Yorkers and people all across this country.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260504-partner_ms_tish_em_demandjustice.giZ6zU&refcode=em20260504-61420&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61420%2E1407376%2EOYpkKX ]The road ahead is going to be long and expensive, and I’m grateful to have Demand Justice
PAC in this fight with me. Will you split a donation of any amount between
Demand Justice PAC and my campaign so we can start this race off strong?

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260504-partner_ms_tish_em_demandjustice.giZ6zU&amount=5&refcode=em20260504-61420&t=1022&akid=61420%2E1407376%2EOYpkKX ]Donate $5 ››

Together, we’ll keep up the fight for justice, progress, and equality.

Thank you,

Tish James
Attorney General of New York

Longer wait times. System outages. Delayed benefits. That's what Michiganders are dealing with in the face of Trump’s cruel cuts to the Social Security Administration.
It's been Trump and Republicans' longtime goal to scrap Social Security and sell it for parts. But, Null, we can't let them.
**Folks have paid into Social Security their entire working lives, so it's only right they see those checks come through after they retire.**

I'll always fight to protect Social Security, but I need to know you're with me. [Will you take a minute to complete my Social Security survey now?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/17855?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=3&akid=2922%2E49239%2EkV5YHZ)

I introduced a new bill to restore Social Security Administration staffing after Trump’s reckless cuts, and I’m fighting to strengthen the services Michigan families rely on.
Because Social Security isn't a handout, Null. It's a benefit that all of us pay into with our hard-earned cash – one that millions of folks count on.
That's what this comes down to. I want these agencies to work for Michiganders because we pay into them.
