## Top NFL Pick Donates $500K for MS
Hours before the Las Vegas Raiders selected him as the [No. 1 overall pick](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskLHSnSAUhJ8GOxxEvGpBkcbuT5vSOcJBuRfB4aBO8vQZM3mEv9vim53d79fX_AU--Lj-hB21W91cXJoj3hSwFMzzjtGmP7D6C2kB8yG_PDjlWQr54qLjQs1HTnSgKbOqrHaIEtsKddP3_Shfg2qqTYNZlBpb5QQOymAjQXbQK0S0jei6pfL6KRSdUFK0SojatcugRKOgXWAcYWRKoPUl5fqdfCwbuvA7XZhrk_Yq6K2Ug1j7g8mJyem-7zrj5fF-pzNHCA_F5ERHyoWYnDJ4i_lJDnOEaBP_f5UHOKPZkLg7o-U2RShIvBPiw0vi-xmKPwJyMgFzIk88IyFks_G2H5tuGJicqqztcfsQPL16psS6g_-3oSrfYfnS8m8AAAD__3dKl4E) in the 2026 NFL Draft, Heisman Trophy winner Fernando Mendoza announced a $500,000 donation to the National MS Society and launched the Mendoza Family Fund in honor of his mother, Elsa, who has lived with multiple sclerosis for nearly 20 years. Fernando skipped attending the draft in Pittsburgh to be with his family in Miami. His mother [delivered an emotional message](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskL1urDAQRp8GOtBgm7_CxW3o9rYprTGMsRODkT3a1ebpo03yCOmPvk_nvN3MDUMM5_4fD9Jud4ZdMic9SiRmyuagc0ufuIc7FYvrRwn2hZdsBIihgb4BZa6cykUrG1Vv2hEJkjXpbhzHWQyT6mqvh3lAO0mwdgZE2Q-Aa69gQrGpFZSog34NQg9KgFQArZN2UtAplBbnGedKAW2BU27fUzjZk4vPdKfcrumoo_bMV6nkv0oslVjKlTKX9ok-pRdQiQUzhzVSqcTiKJ94bqn5tWt-GjRHYk-5cWH3XBqAfpDTCF3r-Yh11tv1CDGGMoyVgv3AEL-_-S-63bX4CgAA__-UJoXF) as she addressed the room: "_I am so proud of not all the successes; you make me so proud --your kindness, your humility, your faith._" The donation launches the [Mendoza Family Fund](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskLGurCAYhJ9GOwwiLmtBcRu7ve0tzS_8IHcRDPxZs-fpT9ycRzjtzGQy3_x7LA8IMST_F3bUzruFXF4SnjUiEZZlx2TzF_jwwrqCedawXvFaFsHFjfGRcbkcJdcDDS2ytdohChxa1L1SahK3u-zbTeOIdjLDypU0PQDgyCelpFBmMIqPfRv0VchHLgUfJOedG9a75L2EYYVpgqmRHG2gXLr_OSTa0MV3fmHpTN7bqDeiozbDn0bMjZjP8-x8zvYiSUhnLs8uF9-IuWchMdqQ2QKOGCTLPpLZoAR6M4clQbKZ_ZCzI6L1aNkG0bE9xBhyYpSZC34jttdGzG3R9jgvq95UI7nfIcTPLvqNT19afAcAAP__komRDQ), which builds on years of fundraising efforts by Fernando and his brother Alberto. The brothers have already raised more than $360,000 through partnerships with local restaurants, creating Cuban-themed menu items with proceeds going to MS research. The initiative aims to raise more than $1 million over the next three years. "_She's the reason we fight, and the reason we believe we can do something bigger than ourselves_ ," Fernando said. "_Together, we can bring us closer to a cure and a future free of MS._ "
## Kids Act after Bus Driver Blacks Out
A group of [Mississippi middle school students](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskLvO3CAUhJ8Gd6yOAd8KijTuNs0qSmlxOdgk2Fgcdlebp4_8P8MvTTej0cz3-77cTUzxWH-aHXVYw1JDXg58U8JasSw7Hj7_M2t8IVnj_lK0V5zKIkD0HDoOajlLphNdXVTjdUAUKBvU7TAMk-hH1TabBvCdMMaCHKauG7teWtXb0SnjghygbaK-CqEDJUAqgFuQdlTQKiOtmSYzMQXoY83l9ifHo24Y0ie_sNxc3pukt1pPYvIHEzMTs7HuOnF5TMy_HkzM71jwUXP5MDHvkejSeUa-R-8TcnJbzolTfXo8KnGq-eT2SdwVQ1s8Vm5CxcJbKWTfAYxN0f58x5Qi9QNTsO4mpq8x9TtAvrT4HwAA__-Bl4vO) jumped into action after their bus driver suffered an asthma attack and lost consciousness on a four-lane highway with about 40 kids on board. Jackson Casnave, 12, was sitting directly behind the driver when the bus began to swerve. He grabbed the wheel and called for help. Darrius Clark, also 12, [slammed on the brakes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskL2unTAQhJ8GOiNjzF_hIg3dSZsSrfECm2Mw8hrIydNfcZ_hStPNaDTz_XmNLyBP-_IbNjTzMo9pDuOON3tMCeO44e7Cf1joQrYwvZnsE-c4KqkaIWsh9XjEwAdOadS5MzOiwipHU7Zt26um02W-mtI2Ste21lLXUGpUfYud022py8452-VknkJZS61kpaUs5sp2WpYaKgt9D32mJTpKIRZ_A-1pxdl_woWxmMKWe7OmdHBW_crUkKnhvu9iDv-eI4-fqeHkTA0bMT86DhIbOedR8LSG4DGy4BQOEc8dbvgIe7JwkS6MwgdGFlPYeaJw8o7MAjitGwhICaZ3Ho07bvKeuGkzLZcNyH_PSj-B9DLqKwAA__94aJJr), and together they guided the bus onto a median and put it in park. Kayleigh Clark, 13, called 911, while Destiny Cornelius, 15, and McKenzy Finch, 13, administered the driver's medication and contacted the school district. "_I didn't have time to process my emotions_ ," Jackson said. "_I just wanted to make sure that nobody got hurt_." Driver Leah Taylor, 46, has made a [full recovery](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskD2u2zAQhE8jdWtQFK2fQkUady9tSmFFLqWNKZLg0npwTh84Zwgw3QwGH75fX-sXcuC4_8STFr_7tfq0RvqWQLVSWU-KLv3BnS-SDe1TePvMpaxa6QHUHZRZc0mSydbVtG7xRJr6lpZuHMdZD5Pp2mPpcDODnj0ZM6O6ox7JO0IzTJ0e7WRaXj6H6q6MVr1R6ub7bTKqM9hvOM84N0aR45rK7XfiWA_y4Z0uKjebzjYsR61Zmv5Hox-NfmRKOdCnavTjZOcCgdgjpQBSX45iFaj4JLAp1pICbC-BXOiiWMEWlIPjDugrFXCFLyogL--pCJzk2GIAOqnsFO0bDow22SecLPJJzgxdN9-nedJtWVz-5hBYhrExaj-Rwz_k-j90X4v-GwAA__9XupwU) and was emotional in thanking her students: "_They're the ones that saved my life and everybody else's on that bus_."
## Ohio Siblings Reunite in Same Nursing Home
After nearly a decade apart, a brother and sister discovered they were living [just a few doors down](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskL1u7CAUhJ8Gd6wwxn8FxW3c7W1TooN9sE-CwQLWm83TR46UN0g5mtHom3m7mzuQp7D-hx21W50pLpqAz-yxFExmx7DEL1jpxGxh_shkr3hORgrZcdFyocyRYj5wLkZVi3aIEpsKdd33_Si7QdXVpjvrcBgsKOtwGXCEobUtdLNqnOhaWVekr0LRCiVFo4S4ucYOStQKGgvjCCNTAhcqMd3eI4WyofOveGK6zXGvvN5KOTJr_jE5MTm5-DlcBpPTNYbJKW4U-S89T_gIVHDh4Aom3gj-QkiZPzEh93RSWDkFnmFHHh4pX3qLOzI5VUkvx5O8p9z1TIl1B_I_EOUvDjy1_A4AAP__VDeKOw) from each other at a nursing facility in Massillon, Ohio. Becky Gibson, 82, moved into Rose Lane Nursing and Rehabilitation in late 2024. In January, her brother, 75-year-old Vietnam veteran Ralph Slawter, moved into the same facility after spending [four decades in Florida](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJys0bGOpiAQwPGnwW6-AKJoYXGN3V57pRlgVG4RDLCf8Z7-4iX3BlvPPzP5ZX59LB_og4_bTzxoWrd1qWtaIl0lUK2Ul4OiS39w828qBu1n8ebJS14klz3wDrhazpzKSbYuqnHTSiSpbWgSWutR9oMSzT4NbSu0IEGuxa4zViojjHZiNFwL3fHGT89C3nEleas4f62tGRQXCluD44gjU5ycrym_ficf605ruNOb8sumownTXutZWPuDyZnJ-bqu1_V522fI5Iy5ehuIyfmhMTnbdBxf0debyXknzLXU_LCYnP8LIdNTEGCFA0vxIaQI8SsXHzfY00GAa6UMkTCHGxAcWXQEeGKukFMhCBifo2MHwvaSK9VDh0aB4kQwWiNgQC24kYN1um_y5M7Lh-BLr5ni24E-_OPV73jNe5J_AwAA__8-vabA). Neither knew the other was there until their daughters connected the dots through social media. A few nights after Ralph arrived, his grandson [wheeled him down the hallway](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbGOnjAQhJ8Guv1lG_ODC4o0dJc2JVrjNTgxNrL3QJenj8gzXDXFjEb69P36WD4wxJC2n3jQ5De_sM9LortGYqayHJRc_otbuKhaXP_UYJ95LYsS6g2iB6GXs-R60sqLbt3kiRR1LU1yGAaj3qOW7T71auzk4Ef1JvPuh9U6Y0gOXSetFaM3bZieQ9ELrUSnhXj5zo5aSI2dRWPQNFqQC5zL63cOiXfy8StfVF5rPto47cxnbbofjZobNd_3_ZKCr6ds1IyFwxqpUfOD9gRyyAnuXKJr1HwF4oQHXMSQo6MCNVSmAoU-U2ACZMh7yJA-Sw1pgz0fBImwxC9AcLSiI8ATCzdq7sUAcjXSIPZgLCrQyq5glfcgvLeDM6vqjGzL5M47xBjqe2i02A4M8T8Of4eKa1L_AgAA__8PqKCF), where he found his sister. The two now spend their days together looking through old photographs and watching the geese on the pond outside. "_I didn't know I'd ever see her again,_ " Ralph said, "_and here we ended up here together_."

body:
The Supreme Court’s decisions are giving us whiplash.
#
Access to mifepristone is under attack again.
In a span of less than 3 days, the Supreme Court created chaos around mifepristone, ordering a nationwide restriction. Then, just a few days later, the Court temporarily restored access again.
But the reality is this:
→ Mifepristone is safe and effective. It’s been used for 26 years, and it’s been tested and proven to be safe and effective.
→ **You can _only_ get mifepristone with a prescription.** This isn't an over-the-counter medication, although it’s just as safe as Tylenol.
→ Its accessibility through mail is important. For many people, being able to get prescribed medication by mail is the difference between getting care and being forced to travel, take time off work, arrange childcare, or miss the legal window entirely.
→**Mifepristone is used in nearly two-thirds of U.S. abortions and is also used for early miscarriage care** , which means restrictions are only going to cause harm.
[**If you agree that abortion care is health care and that mifepristone access shouldn’t be restricted, add your name to our petition right now.**](https://act.leftnet.org/sign/mifepristone-petition/?source=em20260504-1620&t=1&akid=1620%2E2118727%2EEa3DeC)
Anti-abortion groups know they can’t win based on the facts, which is why they choose to create chaos and confusion, force unnecessary barriers, and push women into situations they don’t deserve to be in.
The Supreme Court needs to put an end to this attack on reproductive freedom once and for all. And our elected officials have a responsibility to protect access to health care, not sabotage it.
**[If you support safe, medically supported access to abortion care, please add your name to our petition today.](https://act.leftnet.org/sign/mifepristone-petition/?source=em20260504-1620&t=2&akid=1620%2E2118727%2EEa3DeC)**

Thanks for adding your name to our petition.
— LeftNet

clean_body: The Supreme Court’s decisions are giving us whiplash. Access to mifepristone is under attack again. In a span of less than 3 days, the Supreme Court created chaos around mifepristone, ordering a nationwide restriction. Then, just a few days later, the Court temporarily restored access again. But the reality is this: → Mifepristone is safe and effective. It’s been used for 26 years, and it’s been tested and proven to be safe and effective. → You can only get mifepristone with a prescription. This isn't an over-the-counter medication, although it’s just as safe as Tylenol. → Its accessibility through mail is important. For many people, being able to get prescribed medication by mail is the difference between getting care and being forced to travel, take time off work, arrange childcare, or miss the legal window entirely. →Mifepristone is used in nearly two-thirds of U.S. abortions and is also used for early miscarriage care , which means restrictions are only going to cause harm. Anti-abortion groups know they can’t win based on the facts, which is why they choose to create chaos and confusion, force unnecessary barriers, and push women into situations they don’t deserve to be in. The Supreme Court needs to put an end to this attack on reproductive freedom once and for all. And our elected officials have a responsibility to protect access to health care, not sabotage it. Thanks for adding your name to our petition. — LeftNet LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.

body:
When a campaign can’t win on vision, they try to win on noise. | | | **[CLICK HERE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT KEVIN FORD JR](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fkfordjr.com%2Fmeetkford%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13%26ss_email_id%3D69f905c03991d7335818b8bc%26ss_campaign_name%3DThey%25E2%2580%2599ve%2Bgone%2Bnegative.%2BWe%25E2%2580%2599re%2Bstaying%2Bfocused.%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-04T20%253A48%253A29Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=XZxv9LCAyIfVzfYXAvjb8hoT2Jg%3D)**

| | [](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fkfordweb&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=xOgnsmDIN-6YBRdPYhKw5Veq-W4%3D)
---
####
Here’s the truth: **In the final stretch of this campaign, my opponent has chosen to go negative—circulating attacks meant to distract from the real issues facing District 24.**
#### That’s disappointing, but not surprising.
#### _[**When a campaign can’t win on vision, they try to win on noise.**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13%26ss_email_id%3D69f905c03991d7335818b8bc%26ss_campaign_name%3DThey%25E2%2580%2599ve%2Bgone%2Bnegative.%2BWe%25E2%2580%2599re%2Bstaying%2Bfocused.%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-04T20%253A48%253A29Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=h0WAdPksaIagfoMle7lQFwQ1Zko%3D)_
#### Let me be clear: I’ve always believed in being accountable and transparent with the community I’ve spent my life serving. That won’t change now. I’m proud of the life I’ve built here, the work I’ve done, and the values that guide me every day as a husband, father, and small business owner.
#### But this campaign has never been about me—it’s about you.
#### It’s about:
* #### Making sure families and seniors can afford to stay in our communities
* #### Expanding opportunity for our young people
* #### Ensuring every neighborhood has a voice in Annapolis

#### _[**Negative attacks don’t move us forward. They don’t fix problems. And they don’t reflect the kind of leadership District 24 deserves.**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13%26ss_email_id%3D69f905c03991d7335818b8bc%26ss_campaign_name%3DThey%25E2%2580%2599ve%2Bgone%2Bnegative.%2BWe%25E2%2580%2599re%2Bstaying%2Bfocused.%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-04T20%253A48%253A29Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=h0WAdPksaIagfoMle7lQFwQ1Zko%3D)_
#### What does make a difference is staying focused, showing up, and reaching voters with a real vision for the future.
#### _[**That’s why I’m asking for your support right now.**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13%26ss_email_id%3D69f905c03991d7335818b8bc%26ss_campaign_name%3DThey%25E2%2580%2599ve%2Bgone%2Bnegative.%2BWe%25E2%2580%2599re%2Bstaying%2Bfocused.%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-04T20%253A48%253A29Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=h0WAdPksaIagfoMle7lQFwQ1Zko%3D)_
#### With the June 23rd primary approaching, we need the resources to keep our campaign strong—talking to voters, sharing our message, and building the momentum to win.
#### _[**Can you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can today?**](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69f905c03991d7335818b8bc&u=https%3A%2F%2Fvotekevinford.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13%26ss_email_id%3D69f905c03991d7335818b8bc%26ss_campaign_name%3DThey%25E2%2580%2599ve%2Bgone%2Bnegative.%2BWe%25E2%2580%2599re%2Bstaying%2Bfocused.%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-04T20%253A48%253A29Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f4b4a89063987b71e51f13&l=en-US&s=h0WAdPksaIagfoMle7lQFwQ1Zko%3D)_
#### We’re not backing down. We’re not getting distracted.
#### We’re staying focused on the work—and with your support, we’re going to finish this the right way.
#### Thank you for standing with us.
#### Kevin

Today’s Supreme Court pause on the mifepristone by mail case is a win, but a temporary one.
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/04/us/politics/supreme-court-abortion-pill.html [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/04/us/politics/supreme-court-abortion-pill.html]
This fight is far from over, so I’m sharing a brief explainer on how we got here, and what you can do right now.
Here’s what’s happened so far:
Last week, a federal appeals court ruled to end access to mifepristone prescriptions by mail, one of the most common pills used for medication abortion.
This medication is safe and effective. It was approved by the FDA 25 years ago — back when I was in middle school! And decades of research show that it’s a medication that saves lives.
But a Trump-packed, science-hating court thinks it knows more about your body than you and your health care providers do.
Today, in response to the lower court’s ruling, the Supreme Court temporarily restored nationwide access to mifepristone until at least next Monday.
Here’s where things stand now:
First, it’s important to know that people can still safely and legally access this medication. Doctors can prescribe it, pharmacies can fill the prescription, and patients can receive care.
But the reality is, this mifepristone case is the most serious threat to reproductive freedom since Roe v. Wade was overturned nearly four years ago.
We’ve already seen where this road leads. Trump packed the courts, Roe fell, and abortion bans spread across red states, bringing unnecessary pain, suffering, and death to women all across the country who are seeking safe health care options.
And here in Congress, MAGA Republicans keep trying to chip away at our rights with legislation to further restrict reproductive freedom.
Bottom line: we need to protect reproductive freedom at the federal level. And to do that, we need to flip the House in November.
I’m up for re-election this year, and I could really use your help to make sure we hold my seat, retake the majority in Congress, and fight back against these dangerous attacks on our reproductive freedom. clean_body: [] Today’s Supreme Court pause on the mifepristone by mail case is a win, but a temporary one. [] This fight is far from over, so I’m sharing a brief explainer on how we got here, and what you can do right now. Here’s what’s happened so far: Last week, a federal appeals court ruled to end access to mifepristone prescriptions by mail, one of the most common pills used for medication abortion. This medication is safe and effective. It was approved by the FDA 25 years ago — back when I was in middle school! And decades of research show that it’s a medication that saves lives. But a Trump-packed, science-hating court thinks it knows more about your body than you and your health care providers do. Today, in response to the lower court’s ruling, the Supreme Court temporarily restored nationwide access to mifepristone until at least next Monday. Here’s where things stand now: First, it’s important to know that people can still safely and legally access this medication. Doctors can prescribe it, pharmacies can fill the prescription, and patients can receive care. But the reality is, this mifepristone case is the most serious threat to reproductive freedom since Roe v. Wade was overturned nearly four years ago. We’ve already seen where this road leads. Trump packed the courts, Roe fell, and abortion bans spread across red states, bringing unnecessary pain, suffering, and death to women all across the country who are seeking safe health care options. And here in Congress, MAGA Republicans keep trying to chip away at our rights with legislation to further restrict reproductive freedom. Bottom line: we need to protect reproductive freedom at the federal level. And to do that, we need to flip the House in November. I’m up for re-election this year, and I could really use your help to make sure we hold my seat, retake the majority in Congress, and fight back against these dangerous attacks on our reproductive freedom. Will you chip in today to power this work? Florida got shortchanged in the 2020 Census. For years, Florida’s congressional map didn't reflect who Florida actually is. But the state has changed. The population has grown dramatically. A personal note of gratitude.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130744555/618775834/1328794144?refcode=ea.d40c0c38-fe47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.d40c0c38-fe47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0MGMwYzM4LWZlNDctZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gw4pdg6uUQO6Ge8IcXSYFZfTD38PL7MIEzyp3jC7LRs=&emci=174edea6-e347-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=d40c0c38-fe47-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4823105)

Today feels like the right day to pause and simply say thank you, friend. Your support for my Climate PAC has helped make this community stronger and more connected. Every time you read an email, talk with friends and neighbors about the importance of this work, or show up in whatever way you can, you are helping build something deeply important and necessary. People power begins with how we care for one another. It is strengthened when we organize together, build trust, and remind each other that none of us has to face this moment alone. **That kind of grassroots strength comes from community — from neighbors checking in, conversations that open people up, and invitations that help turn concern into action.** After more than fifty years of doing this work, I know in my heart that if you want to go fast, go alone. **_But if you want to go far, go together._** The labor movement, the civil rights movement, the anti-war movement, and so many others were carried forward by people who understood that their power grew through community, trust, and collective action. We are living through a frightening chapter in history. I won’t pretend otherwise. But this administration is counting on isolation. They’re counting on us going home, locking the door, and assuming our neighbor doesn’t share our values or our fears. The most radical thing any of us can do right now is prove them wrong. That is why I am asking you to keep choosing community. Keep talking to people. Keep showing up. Keep believing that when we know one another, we can build the power we need to protect each other and the future we all deserve. In solidarity, xx Jane | Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. clean_body: A personal note of gratitude. | Today feels like the right day to pause and simply say thank you, friend. Your support for my Climate PAC has helped make this community stronger and more connected. Every time you read an email, talk with friends and neighbors about the importance of this work, or show up in whatever way you can, you are helping build something deeply important and necessary. People power begins with how we care for one another. It is strengthened when we organize together, build trust, and remind each other that none of us has to face this moment alone. That kind of grassroots strength comes from community — from neighbors checking in, conversations that open people up, and invitations that help turn concern into action. After more than fifty years of doing this work, I know in my heart that if you want to go fast, go alone. But if you want to go far, go together. The labor movement, the civil rights movement, the anti-war movement, and so many others were carried forward by people who understood that their power grew through community, trust, and collective action. We are living through a frightening chapter in history. I won’t pretend otherwise. But this administration is counting on isolation. They’re counting on us going home, locking the door, and assuming our neighbor doesn’t share our values or our fears. The most radical thing any of us can do right now is prove them wrong. That is why I am asking you to keep choosing community. Keep talking to people. Keep showing up. Keep believing that when we know one another, we can build the power we need to protect each other and the future we all deserve. In solidarity, xx Jane | Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. Fellow Patriot,

When Senator Daines decided to step down, Montana needed someone to step up.

_**Kurt Alme didn't hesitate.**_

After serving as U.S. Attorney, the job President Trump had nominated him to twice, he jumped into one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. No long deliberation. No waiting to see if the conditions were perfect. He saw that Montana needed him and he said yes.

That tells you everything you need to know about Kurt Alme.

I had the chance to sit down with Kurt recently, and I came away more convinced than ever that he is the right man for this seat. He has spent decades serving Montana as a prosecutor, a tax cutter, and a community servant. He has the record, the values, and the backbone to be an outstanding United States Senator.

He is also starting this race at a disadvantage. He entered late. The other side has had months to build their war chest. And we know from experience that Democrats will spend whatever it takes to try to flip Montana blue.

Kurt doesn't need a handout. He needs conservatives like you to stand behind him early, when it matters most.

ICE is still terrorizing our communities. It doesn’t need to exist.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260504-6210-footer&t=1&akid=6210%2E420207%2EvAgPSV)
Peter,
I need you to know that ICE raids haven’t stopped.
The violent deportations haven’t slowed down. The fear our neighbors are feeling hasn’t gone away.
ICE is terrorizing our communities. Kidnapping and detaining people, breaking down doors without warrants, and tearing families apart in the middle of the night.
They kill U.S. citizens in broad daylight. They snatch elderly people from their homes. And they send our community members to countries entirely unfamiliar to them, with no due process.
There are still families afraid to go to the grocery store for fear of being targeted by ICE. There are still children living in constant fear that their parents might not be there when they get home from school.
No one should have to live like this.
**I want to be clear: ICE has _never_ made our communities safer.** They turn our neighborhoods into hunting grounds and weaponize fear against the most vulnerable communities — all to serve this administration’s cruel authoritarian agenda.
It’s beyond past time to completely dismantle ICE. Our communities cannot afford to wait any longer. This fight belongs to all of us, Peter — that’s why I need you with me on this.
[**Can you add your name to this petition right now to demand Congress dismantle ICE and protect our communities?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260504-dismantle-ice-petition/?source=em20260504-6210&t=2&akid=6210%2E420207%2EvAgPSV)

clean_body: ICE is still terrorizing our communities. It doesn’t need to exist. Peter, I need you to know that ICE raids haven’t stopped. The violent deportations haven’t slowed down. The fear our neighbors are feeling hasn’t gone away. ICE is terrorizing our communities. Kidnapping and detaining people, breaking down doors without warrants, and tearing families apart in the middle of the night. They kill U.S. citizens in broad daylight. They snatch elderly people from their homes. And they send our community members to countries entirely unfamiliar to them, with no due process. There are still families afraid to go to the grocery store for fear of being targeted by ICE. There are still children living in constant fear that their parents might not be there when they get home from school. No one should have to live like this. I want to be clear: ICE has never made our communities safer. They turn our neighborhoods into hunting grounds and weaponize fear against the most vulnerable communities — all to serve this administration’s cruel authoritarian agenda. It’s beyond past time to completely dismantle ICE. Our communities cannot afford to wait any longer. This fight belongs to all of us, Peter — that’s why I need you with me on this. With gratitude, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

body:
#

❗ Friends -- to everybody who cares about our movement for gun safety, please don’t skip this important message.
The Trump administration is trying to change the rules to let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks, licensing, or training — and we need you to help fight back.

Since 1927, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, or licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
Donald Trump is trying to change that.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260504-2-b&t=1&akid=11448%2E3935704%2ESuPxX5)
His Department of Justice recently issued a memorandum saying that they would no longer enforce this ban. Now, the USPS is proposing a change to their existing regulations.

If this rule goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and get a gun mailed to them.
**This change also means that gun traffickers have a new way to move firearms through America’s communities.**
At a time when gun violence is the #1 killer of kids and teenagers in our country...this rule would make us all less safe. We need to fight back.

You have helped us so much fighting back against extremist legislation and passing gun safety laws. Now, we need your support again to push back on this proposed rule.

### "It becomes sacred."

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/conorlambpa/p/to-understand-the-voting-rights-decision?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

The Supreme Court's decision to [gut](https://substack.com/redirect/87b0ee8f-528c-49ea-8d1e-d7a65828801f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Voting Rights Act is about much more than which party controls Congress in 2027. Think about what it says that _**100 years after the end of the Civil War**_ , so many black people still could not vote in the South. Almost overnight, the Voting Rights Act made their right into a reality. I'm not sure how long this will remain but you can still see a Department of Justice [webpage](https://substack.com/redirect/80daccce-9876-48b4-be91-449c436b1bef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that calls it "the single most effective piece of civil rights legislation ever passed by Congress."
I thought about this all weekend because of an experience I had in 2021, which I have not shared much. I was starting to speak in black churches during my Senate campaign, and I asked a pastor from the Kansas City area who was my colleague in Congress, Rep. Emmanuel Cleaver, for advice. Rep. Cleaver had founded his own chapter of the SCLC (Dr. King's organization), and he used to preach to our caucus. When I asked him for help, he told me he would think it over. The next day he found me on the House floor and showed me what he had written out on a yellow pad. I got chills when I found it this weekend:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39b4f6cb-c532-4ba0-9ddb-35e60332779f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This was written in 2021. Today, there are 61 black members of the House and 5 senators. **" That means that God entered the struggle." **There is a little left:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1262d117-70df-4b25-82a0-2a80db31bec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**" As sacred as the waters that rolled back to allow the Israelites to cross the Red Sea." **
Rep. Cleaver took something people think of as primarily political or instrumental, and he revealed its moral character. Real people spilled actual blood for the Voting Rights Act. They believed God was with them. They were living out their purpose on this earth, not jockeying for partisan advantage, which is what the enemies of voting rights are doing today.
Past Congresses understood this distinction. On an overwhelming bipartisan basis, they passed the Voting Rights Act in 1965, and then reauthorized it in 1970, 1982, and 2006. That last time, it passed the Senate 98-0 before President Bush signed it.
If you have heard it argued that the increase in black representation is evidence that we don't need the Voting Rights Act anymore -- rather than evidence of its continued effectiveness -- you should know that Florida passed a new [gerrymander](https://substack.com/redirect/2760e152-648c-4ad9-b3d1-58fc39dc1472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) one hour after the Supreme Court's decision, and many other states have already begun a similar process. They will go on to target an even higher number of black state and local officials, beyond what they do to Congress.
They will have some success. Yet, I have heard hope defined as relating to a "difficult but possible future good." It is in fact possible to offset this damage and perhaps undo it in the future. There are courageous, kindhearted people who are running for office all over this country, and they need your help. It is in the midst of these campaigns that we will decide whether the vision of equality reflected in the Voting Rights Act will be preserved. We won't achieve that without sacrifice, but what choice do we really have?
If hope is hard to come by, there is always the legendary Marine Chesty Puller, who was informed that his men were completely surrounded, and said, "Good! Now we can fire in any direction!" This is a moment of moral clarity in an often ambiguous world. That, in and of itself, is a basis for hope.

Friend, My friend Dan Austin has dedicated his life to Detroit. For decades, he’s been a champion for our city, researching and fighting to preserve its historic spaces while telling stories of Detroiters who changed not only the city, but the world. He runs the beloved and free community resource HistoricDetroit.org, which celebrates and documents our beautifully diverse city. After getting a stage 4 cancer diagnosis, Dan started the [**Austin Past & Future Fund**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoWnkjOF_o06pwEwBbQ_wp_wVt_NjkdPPBlGSNr9DBrIHTeMoE831bU9BaNKTdgjTndT80Fz-lu3xrLzF-Yv4cJa7R8CAVufqTkTwamWMl70sXSF7M07XhWYnT24bpWEeWvzBSEATlOjrCDXNsNYSat_ToeLNG1hpPXsjd-gxnfsEYPdxcvWPdS-HQ9WoK8PpQrMDthQw-VJFXB1x7XxWMpwnbEezHsnOvhBXNHpms8fpB6uSrgiJMr_t71gJRTSkkg/4qc/CMtxA3cjRfK46MHP2g3C2w/h1/h001.QTsK1Wu0SYLJUIZSE-EWm3Fin-l7mfQgxPQGnMVha2A)**** to keep HistoricDetroit.org running and free to all— _but more importantly,_ to provide educational scholarships to Detroit youth who share his commitment to giving back to their communities, such as through careers in teaching, urban planning, social work, or a number of other fields. In this way, the fund is preserving the past while investing in its future. **Dan’s storytelling honors our city’s rich history of change-makers, including Black civil rights leaders and women who blazed new trails—sharing how they responded to oppression while helping us see ourselves as part of a larger, living story.** At the same time, he helped lead the removal of former Mayor Albert Cobo’s name from our convention center after highlighting how his discriminatory policies destroyed Black communities and sought to sow racial divisions in our city. This is history we need to learn from so we can overcome fascism in our time. [**Could you make a tax-deductible donation to Austin Past & Future Fund to carry on my friend Dan’s important work of serving Detroit, supporting our youth, and building our future—even after he’s gone?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoWnkjOF_o06pwEwBbQ_wp_wVt_NjkdPPBlGSNr9DBrIHTeMoE831bU9BaNKTdgjTnUjBWtnTN1wRgik9tkrBfJsejU0BEclFXT8nu7E0wPFKpZLqMnl-HTML4QZncEPr0HWhzX10xBbRzYtN08ZKOa264pJ9ksCjNGjaUD9-Pzztegfz_2UmYg3ikBEwdD37s2XFPWRv4fXh1aStrgz7jtJZqGwfZPGd8OVoGjKCF8_eyOUWRzNVB32SHWbFFCFSrw/4qc/CMtxA3cjRfK46MHP2g3C2w/h2/h001.WX-yjSap77MpR5fofNeEJNAGA3o6cW8plOUZUAw8sFg) | [DONATE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoWnkjOF_o06pwEwBbQ_wp_wVt_NjkdPPBlGSNr9DBrIHTeMoE831bU9BaNKTdgjTnbl6zFrzWbCPV61740MS4NXQfA5CEnpesuERF87nAaH81KhEOPlW5KrJRVtVVyCMNHGT6L2ZxmELgshvLrHas1okHLfSF22rthwWZ0Qo-07mPZvDLoE5IwyrmLsrNEhkS9Nc9BypA2lPl4l0pnybf2HB69LmLjFfSBpTju9dtOt3HtLWgkU2xbrjWkAgSQRlCQ/4qc/CMtxA3cjRfK46MHP2g3C2w/h3/h001.vBbdMvYJ0ut8N1Vf12lCu5vyWFSYvuc1D9-9WNiZaTU)

Thank you for investing in our young leaders of tomorrow and ensuring that we can keep learning about and learning from social change-makers.
With love and hope,
Rashida
P.S. Dan has been an advocate for early cancer screenings, especially as more young people are being diagnosed with colorectal cancer.
He said, _“For me, if I had gotten a colonoscopy at age 40 instead of 43, maybe I would have caught it at Stage 1 or 2 or 3 and still had a chance.”_ Checking with your doctor could save your life.

In the predawn hours of coordinated raids across Washington State, federal agents moved with precision to dismantle one of the most insidious drug trafficking operations the Pacific Northwest had witnessed in years. The August 2025 announcement by the Department of Justice's Western District of Washington revealed the successful disruption of a Sinaloa Cartel-connected distribution network that had weaponized the region's trucking infrastructure to funnel deadly narcotics into American communities.

At the center of the conspiracy stood two brothers from the heart of cartel territory in Sinaloa, Mexico: Rosario Abel "Joaquin" Camargo Banuelos, 31, and Francisco "Fernando" Camargo Banuelos, 24. Operating from their base in Mexico, the brothers allegedly orchestrated a sophisticated smuggling operation that exploited legitimate commercial trucking routes to move massive quantities of methamphetamine and fentanyl across the U.S.-Mexico border and up the Interstate 5 corridor into Washington State.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=194910593&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk0OTEwNTkzLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzc5MzIyMzMsImV4cCI6MTc4MDUyNDIzMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.L7bNui-jMB56et9zrGNrJGjeG5Kg01HQo5TCr7dAxM8)
The case, built over nearly two years of painstaking investigative work, culminated in a 37-count indictment targeting 15 defendants. What distinguished this operation from typical drug prosecutions was its methodical use of the American trucking industry as both weapon and shield. The conspiracy relied on long-haul truckers who transformed routine cargo runs into death deliveries, concealing narcotics in hidden compartments beneath legitimate freight.

Among those charged was Isabel Villarreal Zapien, a 44-year-old Mexican citizen whose career as a commercial truck driver allegedly became indistinguishable from his role as a cartel courier. Arrested initially on state charges in January 2024, Zapien's federal indictment represented a crucial breakthrough in investigators' efforts to understand the network's logistics.

The scope of what investigators uncovered was staggering. In October 2023 alone, law enforcement intercepted shipments containing 95 kilograms of methamphetamine and over 41 kilograms of fentanyl powder--quantities representing approximately 6.9 million lethal doses. To conceptualize the devastation averted, DEA officials noted this poison could have killed virtually every resident of the Seattle-Tacoma metropolitan area.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.TxvoXZMp7lKQSAwgNzaeKvDbm7h7sWVmyHANfq823o4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=194910593)
"This Sinaloa Cartel-affiliated drug trafficking group brought misery and death to our community," declared David F. Reames, Special Agent in Charge of the DEA's Seattle Field Division. "The work of DEA and our partners seized hundreds of pounds of methamphetamine and fentanyl from this group... The entire Puget Sound region is safer without the Camargo Banuelos brothers poisoning our communities."

The investigation exemplified modern interdiction techniques, with undercover agents penetrating the organization throughout 2023 and 2024 to document its operations. Wiretaps, controlled deliveries, and coordinated surveillance across multiple jurisdictions gradually peeled back layers of operational security to reveal the network's architecture.

Acting U.S. Attorney Tessa M. Gorman emphasized the international dimension of the case, stating, "This indictment names not only the redistributors in the Western District of Washington, but also the brothers in Mexico who profited by spreading their poisons and addiction in the Pacific Northwest." Her office pledged continued collaboration with the Department of Justice's Office of International Affairs to ensure accountability across borders.

The prosecution represents a significant tactical victory against the Sinaloa Cartel's increasingly sophisticated efforts to embed itself within legitimate American commerce. By targeting not merely street-level dealers but the logistical infrastructure enabling mass distribution, federal authorities delivered a clear message: the highways carrying American commerce will not become protected corridors for cartel poison.

Dear Patriot, They're trying to put an innocent cop in prison for **life**. Why? For defending himself against a fleeing suspect who dragged him with a car. I've been in law enforcement for decades. I've seen the system abused. But what is happening to Officer James Brennand of San Antonio, Texas makes my blood boil, and it should make yours boil too. On October 2nd, 2022, Officer James Brennand — a decorated Army veteran who swore an oath to protect his community — spotted a car he suspected was stolen outside a McDonald's in San Antonio. He called for backup. He approached the vehicle. He ordered the driver to step out. The driver's response? He threw the car into reverse and used it as a weapon. | [Defend Officer Brennand →](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d0ee9076a8034a40b3903f9a088e5b32&_e=C9L9dujsUW50WTsEQt87BTsgBgWs9wbuZmLbXHJQCNLoHT2rFv7zmDiihwa8F_Kte7bj1h1y_PirNVjiEhle_03a60x-Vd7Xarq7wpyg_mSJSYkHGEVoVQm0QTp_RtEg4MKYcxsmtU_Xd0j3UhkzrsxtGRMj4570Y1eHshkMa9p5gIOqbiOG7zzemK6LkRCNGIn8W5jv4HGeNynuoaHvVcCCyJ9XPJxQFxaRA_qa2C1XV3hiceQlDqlAMmA8cHgTaPEanJBElUV9HSKYa7HZrmTR9N73fjD_1rvRRNK0PtovbJxa8Km3CL1VQmLr_idl8hrcYhizvarimLJ-ADzZLucV0leMJ0d9GumnD81pIT8n7PqF3Z1xgA84BnM9tBJlZJagy6baznlGJrlwLrjcA9myKt6nxzpHPxSkcocLtRKegPqDoqhardIUHtecbHjv)

The car door slammed into Brennand. He was dragged. In that split second — outnumbered, without backup, in genuine danger — James did what every officer is trained to do. **He protected himself.**
The driver survived. The passenger was unharmed. And since that night, the driver has racked up four more arrests. **Four.**
While the man who attacked James faces no meaningful consequences, Officer Brennand has been stripped of his badge, his paycheck, and his future. A politically hungry District Attorney — more interested in headlines than justice — charged James with aggravated assault and deadly conduct. If convicted: **five years to life.**
Let that sink in. A man who served his country in the Army, who volunteered to protect the streets of San Antonio, who was dragged by a car in the line of duty — could die in prison.
[ ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d0ee9076a8034a40b3903f9a088e5b32&_e=C9L9dujsUW50WTsEQt87BTsgBgWs9wbuZmLbXHJQCNLoHT2rFv7zmDiihwa8F_Kte7bj1h1y_PirNVjiEhle_03a60x-Vd7Xarq7wpyg_mTXoNKmvtSd8XZqMyxWGCSeBTCCVEKAQLJjvX-rXpA757dQf7cd6YjbVJM92diRZeLLuHuZ9SwCeA421_LTRqu_JPceQXxjpe0s5EV9wWO2cgCgRnPSb28lQ7Hq2k0OgB4VQQ00qpbIx-AguA_VIquCZ3Xuts8pI_dBJuh1fSuhavpcST1WVTaB5n51S96qF11HC2N-6eh0-HyS_p_cpYy8cpRTdR3DDgemNpykhDG9ptGZljsdQsNsaanfG03mxoffr4rXQ-Kz6S8UaPU6NaVVYvJzUaDenNiVrYvqD9CAXPUNiQeoGeIAy9IwUGDS_exrzUxDNKRe-NjEU6OP9JNY) James and his son — a family now fighting for survival while awaiting trial.
The National Center for Police Defense is in this fight with James — funding his legal defense and supporting his family while this nightmare drags on toward trial. But the costs are staggering, and they don't stop. **[That's why I need you, right now, today, to make a donation. $25. $50. $100.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d0ee9076a8034a40b3903f9a088e5b32&_e=C9L9dujsUW50WTsEQt87BTsgBgWs9wbuZmLbXHJQCNLoHT2rFv7zmDiihwa8F_Kte7bj1h1y_PirNVjiEhle_03a60x-Vd7Xarq7wpyg_mSm9KUolY3V9d_AHW7rlINma0ejNonAeA-V_0oGTZnKrH5oK0iC-VTExD7g06W93_xXNLN0NSFC9jZNFmFXqQMtZvH-3qmqa0bMNp-22BmdB99qgUpS7f7t3f8FZV5BrlLufoj8eiLXoo50vSvKSatCXgiF6ijQrCrBDWaT7PUIwRds1JhNdctDwteGwe9lx-z-xUcIUbZ2elrS5K53Jr1Mf_heAn6dGVkDxsO9c5ZwDAj-85tw9TLND-lztmNzd5id1uVgZSMV_m5fBlnQ0GUMcuiW_cgMVt-k0j1fryw3iLCmskuMOQDk97O_6hh_kMlvbhcGHEbFJxvjg2wrsJJB) ** Whatever you can give. Your gift goes to defending James and keeping his family afloat. The anti-police mob is betting that people like you will scroll past, shake your head, and do nothing. **Prove them wrong.** James Brennand served this country with honor. He served his city with courage. When that car came at him, he stood his ground. Now it's our turn to stand with him. Don't let them take this good man down without a fight. Share this with every patriot and badge supporter you know. The thin blue line holds only as long as good people refuse to look away. **For James. For his son. clean_body: A political DA wants him locked up for life | Dear Patriot, They're trying to put an innocent cop in prison for life. Why? For defending himself against a fleeing suspect who dragged him with a car. I've been in law enforcement for decades. I've seen the system abused. But what is happening to Officer James Brennand of San Antonio, Texas makes my blood boil, and it should make yours boil too. On October 2nd, 2022, Officer James Brennand — a decorated Army veteran who swore an oath to protect his community — spotted a car he suspected was stolen outside a McDonald's in San Antonio. He called for backup. He approached the vehicle. He ordered the driver to step out. The driver's response? He threw the car into reverse and used it as a weapon. | The car door slammed into Brennand. He was dragged. In that split second — outnumbered, without backup, in genuine danger — James did what every officer is trained to do. He protected himself. The driver survived. The passenger was unharmed. And since that night, the driver has racked up four more arrests. Four. While the man who attacked James faces no meaningful consequences, Officer Brennand has been stripped of his badge, his paycheck, and his future. A politically hungry District Attorney — more interested in headlines than justice — charged James with aggravated assault and deadly conduct. If convicted: five years to life. Let that sink in. A man who served his country in the Army, who volunteered to protect the streets of San Antonio, who was dragged by a car in the line of duty — could die in prison. James and his son — a family now fighting for survival while awaiting trial. The National Center for Police Defense is in this fight with James — funding his legal defense and supporting his family while this nightmare drags on toward trial. But the costs are staggering, and they don't stop. Whatever you can give. Your gift goes to defending James and keeping his family afloat. The anti-police mob is betting that people like you will scroll past, shake your head, and do nothing. Prove them wrong. James Brennand served this country with honor. He served his city with courage. When that car came at him, he stood his ground. Now it's our turn to stand with him. Don't let them take this good man down without a fight. Share this with every patriot and badge supporter you know. The thin blue line holds only as long as good people refuse to look away. For James. For his son. For every officer who might be next. Unapologetically, Sheriff Joe Arpaio Former Sheriff, Maricopa County | Stand With Officer Brennand Today Your donation goes to his legal defense and his family. | | - | | ---|---|---|--- National Center for Police Defense 10521 Judicial Drive, Suite 200 Fairfax, Virginia 22030

The biggest lie in politics is that elections are won on Election Day.
They’re not.
**By November, millions of ballots will _already_ be cast.**
Charlie understood this before anyone. In 2024, he mobilized THOUSANDS of full-time ballot-chasers to find and engage with conservatives who don’t normally vote.
Men and women who support the GOP but whose ballots normally sit _untouched_..._unopened_..._unreturned_...
Charlie’s ballot-chasers banked _thousands_ of these early votes and delivered all 5 swing states for President Trump.
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e14754750/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZtY18xNDBrLXZ0X2JyXzIwMjYwMzI1Lw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA1MDQ/LbmNsTEVZSVhXSw/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9MDMyMGVtMSZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMjY5OV93cjM/gafkcnQ/sfq0e26f755)
**[That’s why Turning Point PAC is building a massive war chest RIGHT NOW to (again) fund the LARGEST ballot-chasing operation in America.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e14754750/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZtY18xNDBrLXZ0X2JyXzIwMjYwMzI1Lw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA1MDQ/LbmNsTEVZSVhXSw/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9MDMyMGVtMSZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMjY5OV93cjM/gafkcnQ/sfq0e26f755)**
We want to unleash **700 NEW BALLOT-CHASERS** to keep pace with the Left’s turnout machine.

[Sponsor 1 Ballot-Chaser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e14754750/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZtY18xNDBrLXZ0X2JyXzIwMjYwMzI1Lw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA1MDQ/LbmNsTEVZSVhXSw/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9MDMyMGVtMSZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMjY5OV93cjMmYW1vdW50PTUw/gafkcnQ/s2vd3432c9a)
The math is simple.
Each of these 700 ballot-chasers will:
➡️ Court unengaged voters RIGHT NOW ➡️ Help them make a plan to vote ➡️ **Bank 10 ballots per day** in the voting period
That’s **7,000 votes** banked daily...
That’s **140,000+ votes LOCKED-IN** before Election Day. And that’s just _this_ class of 700.
Enthusiasm isn’t enough. House races are often decided by **fewer than 5,000 votes** and Senate races by **less than 1%**.

_**by Eric Lullove, DPM | Board-Certified Podiatric Surgeon, Contributing Medical Editor, Blue Amp Media**_
_The lab coats fade like morning mist, the microscopes are blurred. A thousand years of 'how' and 'why' are silenced by a word._
-- Dr. Eric Lullove, "The Unmaking of the Shield," March 2026
Let me tell you about a patient I saw not long ago. Diabetic. No insurance--got kicked off the ACA when his restaurant job disappeared. Walked into my office in Coconut Creek with a 3 cm ulcer eating through the plantar surface of his right forefoot. Six other clinics had turned him away. Some wanted $250 to $400 per visit. One didn't call him back. I put him in a treatment room, debrided the wound, did a full vascular workup, fitted him with a walking boot, and wrote scripts for generic meds he could actually afford.
When he asked how much he owed, my office manager said: zero. He cried. I walked him to the door and told him what I tell everyone: you pay it forward. That's the medicine I practice. That's the oath I took.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/568688e0-be03-4b4c-8b4c-a0600dc1f901?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now I'm watching a group of men--some in federal office, some on Sand Hill Road, some in both places simultaneously--dismantle the infrastructure that allows any of this to work, all while wrapping themselves in the language of health and wellness. And what they're building in its place has a name. It's not a new name. It's a very old one. I want to talk about it plainly, as a physician and as someone who has spent a career watching what happens when systems decide certain bodies aren't worth the investment.
## What We're Actually Talking About When We Talk About Eugenics
I'm going to use the word. I know it makes people uncomfortable. Good. It should.
Eugenics is not a slur I'm throwing to score political points. It is a documented historical program--one that began in Victorian England, became mainstream American science by 1910, was enshrined in law across 32 U.S. states, led to the involuntary sterilization of an estimated 60,000 Americans, and provided the intellectual scaffolding that Nazi doctors cited by name at Nuremberg. The word has a precise meaning: the attempt to improve the human species by controlling who reproduces and who receives resources--based on criteria that were never biological, only social, racial, and economic.
Francis Galton, Charles Darwin's cousin, coined it in 1883. He called it "the science of improving stock." The stock he had in mind was not ambiguous. It was white, educated, Anglo-Saxon, and economically productive. Everyone else was a liability to be managed, reduced, or eliminated. This was not a fringe idea. It was the consensus of the most credentialed scientists of the era. It was taught at Harvard. It was endorsed by presidents. The Supreme Court upheld it in _Buck v. Bell_ in 1927--Oliver Wendell Holmes, a justice we were taught to revere, writing that "three generations of imbeciles are enough."
_Eugenics wasn 't a science that got corrupted. It started corrupt. The science was always cover for the social hierarchy._
-- Dr. Eric Lullove
After World War II, the word died. The logic didn't. It metastasized into other vocabularies--into race-based clinical algorithms, into who gets experimental treatments and who gets palliative comfort, into which zip codes have dialysis centers and which ones don't. Harriet Washington documented this in _**Medical Apartheid**_. Dorothy Roberts documented it in _**Fatal Invention**_. As a wound care specialist who treats the consequences of diabetic neglect every single day, I can tell you this is not history. This is last Tuesday.
What I want to describe now is what happens when that logic gets a tech upgrade, a government appointment, and $70 billion in venture capital.
## MAHA: The Parts That Are Real, and the Parts That Should Terrify You
I want to be fair here, because I think intellectual honesty requires it and because my patients deserve analysis, not cheerleading.
The chronic disease crisis in America is real. I see it in my clinic every week--diabetic patients who cannot afford insulin, wound patients whose conditions are the direct consequence of a lifetime of poor nutrition driven by food deserts, environmental toxin exposure, and stress-related inflammation. The processed food system is genuinely harmful. The pharmaceutical industry has genuinely corrupted aspects of the regulatory apparatus. These are not conspiracy theories. They are documented facts that mainstream medicine has been too politically timid to state plainly.
So when Robert F. Kennedy Jr. says he wants to address those things, part of me--the physician part, the part that has watched patients lose limbs they didn't have to lose--wants to listen.
But then I look at what MAHA actually does. And what it does is not fix the system. It guts the oversight that constrains the worst impulses of the system, while replacing independent scientific authority with political loyalists and tech-bro ideologues.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/568688e0-be03-4b4c-8b4c-a0600dc1f901?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The pattern is not incompetence. Incompetent people don't move this fast. The pattern is deliberate: remove the watchdogs, install the ideologues, and then build the new system while no one is looking at the old one burning down.
## The Men Behind the Curtain--And Why Their Worldview Should Alarm You
#### **The Thiel Network**
I want to talk about Peter Thiel. Not because he's a cartoon villain--he's not. He's a genuinely intelligent man with a coherent worldview. That's what makes him dangerous. Stupid people with bad ideas don't reshape governments. Smart people with bad ideas do.
Thiel is one of the most powerful private citizens in the history of American health policy, and most mainstream health coverage barely mentions him. His fingerprints are all over the current HHS, and I think the public deserves to understand exactly how that happened.
_In a 2025 New York Times interview, Thiel was asked directly: "Would you prefer the human race to endure?" He hesitated. At length. Before reluctantly saying yes--and then immediately pivoting to transhumanism. The interviewer, Ross Douthat, noted the hesitation on the record._
This is not a gotcha. It's a window. What Thiel envisions--and has invested billions in--is not the preservation of human life as most of us understand it. It is the radical transformation of human biology, achievable by those with the means to access it, into something new. He has described wanting to "change your heart and change your mind and change your whole body." He has backed companies offering embryo genetic screening--what bioethicists call a commercial realization of eugenics. He has reportedly paid to have his body cryogenically preserved. He has invested in nearly 12 longevity companies that have collectively raised over $70 billion.
That would all be his personal business--however strange--if his network were not now embedded in the federal agencies that decide what drugs get approved, what research gets funded, and who gets care.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/568688e0-be03-4b4c-8b4c-a0600dc1f901?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### **Jim O 'Neill: This Is the Person Who Ran Your CDC**
I want to pause on Jim O'Neill specifically, because his career trajectory is the clearest picture of what is actually happening inside HHS right now.
O'Neill ran the Thiel Foundation. Then he ran Mithril Capital--a Thiel fund that backed Palantir, the surveillance and data company. Then he ran SENS Research Foundation, an anti-aging nonprofit dedicated to what it calls "rejuvenation medicine"--its stated goals include "rejuvenating the immune system, eliminating senescent cells, rejuvenating the neocortex, and obviating mitochondrial mutations." That is the language of life-extension science. That is the world this man came from.
In June 2025, he was sworn in as Deputy Secretary of HHS. By August 2025, he was simultaneously the acting director of the CDC. The number-two health official in the United States and the head of the nation's disease control agency was a man whose career was in Thiel's longevity-investment ecosystem.
He then proceeded to deploy AI tools across all 65,000 HHS employees. He brought in Clark Minor--an ex-Palantir executive--as HHS Chief Information Officer. He contracted with OpenAI, xAI, and Anthropic. And he did all of this while publicly opposing the kind of regulatory framework that would require these AI systems to be audited for bias, accuracy, and demographic equity.
#### **From the Exam Room**
Here is what this looks like from inside a wound care clinic. Insurance companies already use AI algorithms to make prior authorization decisions. My diabetic patients--disproportionately Black, Latino, and low-income--are already being scored, tiered, and routed by systems built on data that reflect decades of healthcare inequality. When those algorithms underestimate someone's health need because Black patients historically used services less (due to systemic barriers, not lesser need), the algorithm doesn't correct for that. It encodes it. It makes it permanent. It calls it math.
Now imagine that ecosystem--unregulated, unaudited, politically captured--governing Medicare payment decisions, FDA approval timelines, NIH research priorities, and CDC disease surveillance. That is what is being built. Right now. At speed.
## Transhumanism Is Eugenics With a Better PR Department
I want to give credit to philosophers Émile Torres and Timnit Gebru for naming this clearly. Their TESCREAL framework--Transhumanism, Extropianism, Singularitarianism, Cosmism, Rationalism, Effective Altruism, Longtermism--describes the constellation of ideologies that have become, as Torres puts it, "the water Silicon Valley swims in." I'd go further: it is the ideological operating system of the people now running American health policy.
Torres's analysis is worth sitting with: transhumanism was literally invented by a eugenicist. Julian Huxley--who coined "transhumanism" in 1957--was one of the leading eugenicists of the twentieth century. He described transhumanism as eugenics freed from the limitation of aiming at mere human improvement, toward the creation of "a new existence." The lineage is not metaphorical. It is direct.
_Transhumanism is eugenics on steroids. The old eugenicists just wanted to improve the species. Transhumanists say: why stop there?_
-- Émile Torres, _**Jacobin**_ , November 2025
The critical difference between the old eugenics and the new is the mechanism of sorting. The old kind used state coercion--sterilization laws, immigration restrictions, institutionalization. The new kind uses market selection. You don't need a government order to deny certain people access to the best healthcare if you price it out of their reach. The outcome is the same. The paperwork is different.
* **Algorithmic discrimination in risk scoring:** AI care management tools have been documented systematically underrepresenting Black patients at equivalent illness levels because they use past expenditure--not actual need--as a proxy for health risk. This is not a bug. This is training data.
* **Diagnostic tool bias:** AI dermatology platforms trained primarily on light-skin data perform significantly worse on darker skin tones. Delayed cancer detection. For populations already facing the greatest disparities.
* **Embryo selection at scale:** Thiel-adjacent capital has backed commercial genetic embryo screening that offers wealthy parents "optimized" offspring. Bioethicists have documented the direct lineage from this technology to classical eugenics.
* **Longevity as a class project:** The billionaires funding anti-aging research are not doing it for everyone. They are doing it for themselves. The trickle-down theory of immortality has not been road-tested.

## What I'll Grant Them--And Where I Draw the Line
I'm a physician. I follow the evidence. And the evidence does support some of what MAHA claims to want.
Chronic disease in America is a legitimate crisis. Food additives and dyes deserve scrutiny. Environmental contamination is a real driver of health outcomes--I see the consequences in my patients' wounds, in their vascular disease, in their impaired healing. The pharmaceutical lobby has corrupted aspects of the FDA. These criticisms are not wrong.
But MAHA is not executing on those goals through evidence-based policy. It is executing on those goals through the destruction of institutional capacity and its replacement with politically captured, ideologically motivated actors who happen to share investment interests in the privatization of American medicine.
**You cannot fix a corrupt FDA by removing the scientists who check the corruption.** You cannot improve vaccine safety by firing the independent experts who evaluate vaccines and replacing them with vaccine skeptics. You cannot address the root causes of chronic disease by citing studies that don't exist. And you cannot build an equitable AI healthcare system by putting a Palantir executive in charge of HHS data infrastructure and removing the regulatory framework that would require that system to treat all patients fairly.
_The question isn 't whether AI can help American healthcare. It obviously can. The question is: who controls it, whose data trained it, and who gets left out when it decides your body isn't worth the cost._
-- Dr. Eric Lullove, _**The Wound Report**_
## What Evidence-Based Policy Actually Requires Here
As a physician, I want to be constructive. Criticism without a standard is just noise. Here is what genuine healthcare reform that doesn't reproduce eugenic logic would require:
* **Mandatory algorithmic auditing** with demographic disaggregation of outcomes for any AI system used in prior authorization, risk scoring, or care allocation. If your algorithm systematically under-identifies health need in Black patients, that is not an acceptable product.
* **Restored FDA authority** over AI-based medical devices and diagnostic tools. Jim O'Neill's career-long opposition to this position is a disqualification for anyone overseeing American health infrastructure, not a qualification.
* **Conflict-of-interest prohibitions** barring officials with financial stakes in longevity biotech from regulating or overseeing the industries they profit from. The revolving door between Thiel-adjacent venture funds and HHS leadership is a design flaw that needs to be treated as such.
* **Reconstitution of independent scientific advisory bodies --**genuinely independent, with transparent selection criteria and protection from mass political dismissal. The ACIP should not be the secretary's personal advisory panel.
* **Equity requirements** for any longevity or precision medicine research receiving federal funding. If public dollars fund the science, public access must be part of the outcome.

None of these are radical demands. Most existed before 2025. The damage can be reversed. But reversal requires naming what is happening clearly enough that people understand what they're reversing.
## What I See From the Exam Room
I want to end where I started--at the level of the body. Because that is where all of this eventually lands.
When an insurance company AI denies a prior authorization for a diabetic wound patient who needed debridement two weeks ago, they don't come back with a gangrenous toe. They come back with a gangrenous foot. And then you amputate. And that amputation--the cost of which exceeds every single visit that was denied--is now on Medicare. Which is funded by taxpayers. Which means the system that denied care to save money ended up costing more money, while the patient lost a limb they didn't have to lose.
That is not an edge case in my practice. That is most Tuesdays.
The people building this new AI healthcare system--the longevity investors, the transhumanist technocrats, the ideological appointees who think the FDA is the problem--do not spend their Tuesdays in wound care clinics. They spend them in board meetings and on private jets and at conferences with names like "Longevity Summit" where they discuss reversing the aging of their own cells.
Their bodies are not the ones in the system they're designing.
The bodies in the system they're designing are the bodies I treat. The uninsured line cook with the diabetic ulcer. The elderly Black patient whose prior authorization was denied by an algorithm that underestimated her need because her zip code historically underutilized services. The veteran whose wound won't close because the systemic factors driving it--the diet, the environmental exposure, the chronic stress--are exactly what MAHA claims to address while building a system that has no intention of addressing them for people who cannot pay.
The word they silenced--the one that names what is actually being built here--is one we have said before. We said it in laboratories in Virginia and Indiana and California before the war. We heard it back in German from Nuremberg. We buried it after a suitable mourning period and told ourselves it was gone.
It wasn't gone. It just hired a publicist and started a wellness newsletter.
**I 'm a physician. My job is diagnosis. Consider this a diagnosis.**
**-- Eric Lullove, DPM**

The question isn 't whether AI can help American healthcare. It obviously can. The question is: who controls it, whose data trained it, and who gets left out when it decides your body isn't worth the cost. -- Dr. Eric Lullove, The Wound Report What Evidence-Based Policy Actually Requires Here As a physician, I want to be constructive. Criticism without a standard is just noise. Here is what genuine healthcare reform that doesn't reproduce eugenic logic would require: Mandatory algorithmic auditing with demographic disaggregation of outcomes for any AI system used in prior authorization, risk scoring, or care allocation. If your algorithm systematically under-identifies health need in Black patients, that is not an acceptable product. Restored FDA authority over AI-based medical devices and diagnostic tools. Jim O'Neill's career-long opposition to this position is a disqualification for anyone overseeing American health infrastructure, not a qualification. Conflict-of-interest prohibitions barring officials with financial stakes in longevity biotech from regulating or overseeing the industries they profit from. The revolving door between Thiel-adjacent venture funds and HHS leadership is a design flaw that needs to be treated as such. Reconstitution of independent scientific advisory bodies --genuinely independent, with transparent selection criteria and protection from mass political dismissal. The ACIP should not be the secretary's personal advisory panel. Equity requirements for any longevity or precision medicine research receiving federal funding. If public dollars fund the science, public access must be part of the outcome. None of these are radical demands. Most existed before 2025. The damage can be reversed. But reversal requires naming what is happening clearly enough that people understand what they're reversing. What I See From the Exam Room I want to end where I started--at the level of the body. Because that is where all of this eventually lands. When an insurance company AI denies a prior authorization for a diabetic wound patient who needed debridement two weeks ago, they don't come back with a gangrenous toe. They come back with a gangrenous foot. And then you amputate. And that amputation--the cost of which exceeds every single visit that was denied--is now on Medicare. Which is funded by taxpayers. Which means the system that denied care to save money ended up costing more money, while the patient lost a limb they didn't have to lose. That is not an edge case in my practice. That is most Tuesdays. The people building this new AI healthcare system--the longevity investors, the transhumanist technocrats, the ideological appointees who think the FDA is the problem--do not spend their Tuesdays in wound care clinics. They spend them in board meetings and on private jets and at conferences with names like "Longevity Summit" where they discuss reversing the aging of their own cells. Their bodies are not the ones in the system they're designing. The bodies in the system they're designing are the bodies I treat. The uninsured line cook with the diabetic ulcer. The elderly Black patient whose prior authorization was denied by an algorithm that underestimated her need because her zip code historically underutilized services. The veteran whose wound won't close because the systemic factors driving it--the diet, the environmental exposure, the chronic stress--are exactly what MAHA claims to address while building a system that has no intention of addressing them for people who cannot pay. The word they silenced--the one that names what is actually being built here--is one we have said before. We said it in laboratories in Virginia and Indiana and California before the war. We heard it back in German from Nuremberg. We buried it after a suitable mourning period and told ourselves it was gone. It wasn't gone. It just hired a publicist and started a wellness newsletter. I 'm a physician. My job is diagnosis. Consider this a diagnosis. -- Eric Lullove, DPM Independent, uncaptured journalism like Eric's is the only place a story like this can be told without somebody upstairs softening it for an advertiser or a sponsor. We can do it because you fund it. --five bucks a month, less than a bad sandwich. Can't swing it? Then share this piece with someone who needs to read it... ... and drop a comment below --Eric reads them, and so do I. Every subscription, every donation, every share, every comment is a punch back at the people who'd rather you stay quiet about what's happening to American medicine. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately.
